# Time the ERP stage keeps before the research deadline, so that what it started finishes and counts: a material's
# reader call after its worker stops (READ_SECONDS), the model's choice over the records (CHOOSE_SECONDS); a search
# starts only with time for a material after it (MATERIAL_SECONDS).
READ_SECONDS = 35.0
CHOOSE_SECONDS = 15.0
MATERIAL_SECONDS = 90.0
STEP_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("ERP_STEP_SECONDS", "5"))  # one model step and its browser action, under load


UNFINISHED = "materials not all read by the research deadline"


def steps(until: float | None, floor: int, cap: int) -> int:
    """A worker's step limit: what the time until `until` allows at about STEP_SECONDS a step, between `floor`
    and `cap` (the cap only stops loops; the deadline stops the worker anyway)."""
    if until is None:
        return cap
    return int(max(floor, min(cap, (until - time.monotonic()) / STEP_SECONDS)))


GATE_GOAL = """\
Get past the sign-in, notice or confirmation page this system shows (copy any number it asks you to transfer
exactly) and return as soon as a page of the system itself shows (a main menu, transaction or material screen).
Open nothing else."""


def incomplete(record: MaterialRecord) -> list[str]:
    """Facts every bid needs from a material that its record still lacks."""
    checks = {"status": bool(record.status.strip(" ()")), "free stock": record.free_stock is not None,
              "lead time from stock": record.stock_lead_time_weeks is not None,
              "production lead time": record.production_lead_time_weeks is not None,
              "price conditions with their quantity scales": bool(record.conditions)
              and not any("scales not read" in p for p in record.problems),
              "pieces per carton": record.pieces_per_carton is not None,
              "allocation and surcharge masses": record.allocation_mass_kg is not None
              and record.surcharge_mass_kg is not None}
    return [name for name, ok in checks.items() if not ok]


class ErpResearch(BaseModel):
    requirements: list[RequirementResearch] = Field(default_factory=list)
    materials: dict[str, MaterialRecord] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    seconds: float = 0


SALVAGE_SEARCH = """\
You read the page a browsing worker ended on in an ERP. If it lists material hits of a search for catalogue group
{group}, report the search term shown and every listed hit of that group with its link target and the technical
attributes the list shows, exactly as written. If it shows no such hit list, return an empty list of candidates."""


async def _salvage_search(session: SiteSession, views: dict[str, str], group: str) -> SearchReport | None:
    """The hits on the latest page of a stopped search worker that lists the group with links (one grounded reader
    call), or None."""
    text = next((t for t in reversed(views.values()) if group in t and "->" in t), "")
    if not text:
        return None
    try:
        report = await asyncio.wait_for(_grounded_read(
            SearchReport, SALVAGE_SEARCH.format(group=group), f"Page:\n{text[:16000]}", text, trace=session.trace,
            name=session.name, what="search salvage"), 60)
    except Exception as error:
        session.trace.event(session.name, "search_salvage_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
        return None
    return report if report.candidates else None


class Erp:
    """
    The ERP website: one signed-in context and a few reused tabs, so requirements and materials run in parallel.

    The ERP drops its session after some idle minutes and when several tabs sign in at once. Sign-ins are therefore
    serialised over the tabs, and a tab that lands somewhere other than the view it asked for (a sign-in, an entry
    gate) gets one model worker past the gate (`recover`, one tab at a time) and opens its view again.
    """

    def __init__(self, site: dict, context: BrowserContext, trace: Trace, deadline: float | None = None):
        self.site, self.context, self.trace, self.deadline = site, context, trace, deadline
        self.ready: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.materials: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        self.tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        # a few tabs at once: every tab is one more page load on a site that slows down under load
        self.tabs = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("ERP_TABS", "6")))
        self.idle_pages: list[Page] = []  # open tabs a finished worker left, reused instead of a fresh start
        self.opening = asyncio.Lock()  # fresh tabs sign in one after another
        self.signin = asyncio.Lock()  # one sign-in at a time
        self.signins = 0
        self.checking = asyncio.Lock()  # one idle check at a time
        self.gate = asyncio.Lock()  # one tab gets past an entry gate at a time
        self.passes = 0  # gates passed; a tab that waited for another one's pass just opens its view again
        self.gate_paths: set[str] = set()  # paths of the sign-in / notice gates seen
        self.home = ""  # the path the start address lands on while signed in and past the gate
        self.busy = 0  # workers using the ERP now
        self.active_at = 0.0  # last time a worker used it
        self.idle_limit = float(os.environ.get("ERP_IDLE_SECONDS", "120"))  # the ERP drops idle sessions
        self.partial: dict[str, RequirementResearch] = {}  # requirement -> research whose search has finished

content.content:
self.partial: dict[str, RequirementResearch] = {}  # requirement -> research whose search has finished
        self.started_at: float | None = None

    def left(self) -> float:
        return float("inf") if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - time.monotonic()

    def _until(self, reserve: float) -> float | None:
        return None if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - reserve

    def warm_up(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Sign in and get past entry gates once (a model handles gates the helpers cannot), e.g. while the
        specification is still being read."""
        if self.ready is None:
            self.ready = asyncio.create_task(self._warm_up())
        return self.ready

    async def _warm_up(self) -> None:
        async with self.gate:
            session = await self._worker_tab("start")
            if session is None:  # the workers' own tabs try again
                return
            try:
                await self._pass_gate(session)
            finally:
                await self._close(session)

    async def _pass_gate(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """A model gets the tab past the sign-in / notice gate; then the start address shows where a signed-in
        tab lands (`home`). Called with `gate` held."""
        if not await self._at_home(session):  # the page it is on is a gate (a later drop may land there again)
            self.gate_paths.add(urlparse(session.page.url).path or "/")
        await run_worker(session, GATE_GOAL, Ready, deadline=self._until(0), max_steps=8,
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        self.passes += 1
        async with session.lock:
            await session._goto(self.site["url"])
        await session.look()
        if not session.view.startswith("(") and not await self._signin_form(session):
            self.home = urlparse(session.page.url).path or "/"
        self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    @staticmethod
    async def _signin_form(session: SiteSession) -> bool:
        try:
            return bool(await session.page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count())
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def _at_home(self, session: SiteSession) -> bool:
        return bool(self.home) and (urlparse(session.page.url).path or "/") == self.home \
            and not await self._signin_form(session)

    async def _at_gate(self, session: SiteSession) -> bool:
        return (urlparse(session.page.url).path or "/") in self.gate_paths or await self._signin_form(session)

    async def recover(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """The tab did not reach its view (session dropped, entry gate): get past the gate once for all tabs."""
        if not await self._at_gate(session):  # e.g. a view that redirects elsewhere: not a dropped session
            return
        passes = self.passes
        async with self.gate:
            if self.passes != passes:  # another tab passed the gate while this one waited
                return
            self.trace.event(session.name, "erp_recover", url=session.page.url)
            await self._pass_gate(session)

    async def ensure(self) -> None:
        """Before a worker starts: the session signed in. After the ERP sat idle (it drops idle sessions), one tab
        checks it and passes the gate again if needed, before the other workers pile in and sign in at once."""
        await self.warm_up()
        if self.busy or time.monotonic() - self.active_at < self.idle_limit:
            return
        async with self.checking:
            if self.busy or time.monotonic() - self.active_at < self.idle_limit:
                return  # another worker checked meanwhile
            session = await self._worker_tab("check")  # a tab that does not land at home passes the gate again
            if session is not None:
                await self._close(session)
            self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    def _guard_login(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """Sign-ins one tab at a time; a tab that waited while another signed in first reloads, since the shared
        context may already be signed in again."""
        login = session._login

        async def serialised(page: Page) -> bool:
            if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                return False
            signins = self.signins
            async with self.signin:
                if self.signins != signins:
                    try:
                        await page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                        session.events.append("another tab signed in; reloaded")
                        return True
                done = await login(page)
                if done:
                    self.signins += 1
                    await asyncio.sleep(1.0)  # let the sign-in land before the next tab acts
                return done

        session._login = serialised  # type: ignore[method-assign]

    async def _tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession:
        """A tab in the shared context (a reused one when a finished worker left it); `tag` names it in the
        trace. With `url`, the tab opens that link target, else the start address."""
        session = SiteSession({**self.site, "siteId": f"{self.site['siteId']}:{tag}"}, self.context, self.trace)
        self._guard_login(session)
        session.recover = lambda: self.recover(session)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        page = None
        while self.idle_pages and page is None:
            candidate = self.idle_pages.pop()
            page = None if candidate.is_closed() else candidate
        if page is not None:
            session.scripted = True  # the context already has the popup closer
            session._watch(page)
            if not url:
                async with session.lock:
                    await session._goto(self.site["url"])
                await session.look()
        else:
            async with self.opening:
                await session.start()
        if url:
            await self.open(session, url)
        elif self.home and not await self._at_home(session):  # dropped: one tab passes the gate for all
            await self.recover(session)
            async with session.lock:
                await session._goto(self.site["url"])
            await session.look()
        return session

    @contextlib.asynccontextmanager
    async def _slot(self):
        """A tab slot for one worker, with the session checked first."""
        await self.ensure()
        async with self.tabs:
            self.busy += 1
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                self.busy -= 1
                self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    async def open(self, session: SiteSession, url: str) -> bool:
        """Open a link target a model reported, with the same rule as the goto tool: only on this website. A tab
        that lands elsewhere (sign-in, entry gate) recovers once and opens it again."""
        target = on_site(self.site, url)
        if target is None:
            self.trace.event(session.name, "link_refused", url=url)
            return False
        for attempt in range(2):
            async with session.lock:
                await session._goto(target)
            await session.look()
            landed, wanted = urlparse(session.page.url), urlparse(target)
            if (landed.path, landed.query) == (wanted.path, wanted.query):
                session.__dict__.setdefault("opened", set()).add(target)
                return True
            if not attempt:
                await self.recover(session)
        return False

    async def _close(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """Hand the worker's tab back for reuse (popups it opened are closed)."""
        kept = False
        for page in session.pages:
            try:
                page.remove_listener("dialog", session._on_dialog)
                page.remove_listener("popup", session._on_popup)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if not kept and not page.is_closed() and len(self.idle_pages) < 8:
                self.idle_pages.append(page)
                kept = True
                continue
            try:
                await page.close()
            except Exception:  # already gone
                continue

    async def _worker_tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession | None:
        try:  # a tab that does not open costs this attempt, not the research
            return await self._tab(tag, url)
        except Exception as error:
            self.trace.event("erp", "tab_failed", tag=tag, error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return None

    async def requirement(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> RequirementResearch:
        out = RequirementResearch(requirement_id=req.requirement_id)
        report = None
        until = self._until(MATERIAL_SECONDS)
        for attempt in range(2):  # retry once: the ERP sometimes drops the session mid-search
            if self.left() < MATERIAL_SECONDS + 20:
                break
            async with self._slot():
                session = await self._worker_tab(req.requirement_id if not attempt else f"{req.requirement_id}+")
                if session is None:
                    continue
                views = _keep_views(session)
                try:
                    report, _ = await run_worker(
                        session, SEARCH_GOAL.format(group=req.catalog_group), SearchReport,
                        deadline=until, max_steps=steps(until, 6, 16), tools=(site_tools.search, site_tools.collect),
                        **_worker_kwargs(notes=False))
                    if report is None:  # stopped (steps, time): the hit list it ended on may still be there
                        report = await _salvage_search(session, views, req.catalog_group)
                finally:
                    await self._close(session)
            if report is not None:
                break
        if report is None:
            out.problems.append("search worker returned no result")
            return out
        out.search_term = report.search_term
        out.candidates = [Candidate(material_number=c.material_number.strip(), link=c.link.strip(),
                                    bore=_num(c.bore), stroke=_num(c.stroke), pressure=_num(c.pressure),
                                    mounting=c.mounting, certification=c.certification)
                          for c in report.candidates]
        # every hit of the model's search is inspected (the rules cap a usable search at 20 hits); which one fits is
        # the model's choice below, once the details are known
        out.inspected = list(dict.fromkeys(c.material_number for c in out.candidates))[:MAX_INSPECT]
        if len(out.candidates) > MAX_INSPECT:
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.candidates)} hits, inspected the first {MAX_INSPECT}")
        # until the choice below is made, the research stands with its hits marked unfinished (so_far): a later
        # choice can still find the exact match among the materials read, and no match omits the position
        out.problems.append(UNFINISHED)
        self.partial[req.requirement_id] = out
        links = {c.material_number: c.link for c in out.candidates}
        tasks = [self.material(number, links.get(number, "")) for number in out.inspected]
        # material workers stop early enough for their reader; a record still open at the deadline is left out
        # and the choice is made over the ones that are complete
        done = set()
        if tasks:
            done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=max(1.0, self.left() - CHOOSE_SECONDS))
        materials = {}
        for task in tasks:
            if task in done and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None and task.result() is not None:
                materials[task.result().material_number] = task.result()
        if len(materials) < len(out.inspected):
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.inspected) - len(materials)} of {len(out.inspected)} materials not read")
        try:
            out.selected, problems = await asyncio.wait_for(choose_material(req, out, materials, self.trace),
                                                            max(1.0, self.left() - 2))
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            out.selected, problems = None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no choice before the research deadline"]
        out.problems = [p for p in out.problems if p != UNFINISHED] + problems
        return out

    def so_far(self) -> ErpResearch:
        """What the ERP stage has at the deadline: finished requirements, the ones whose search finished (hits
        marked unfinished), and every finished material record."""
        results = []
        for k in sorted(self.tasks, key=calc.position_key):
            task = self.tasks[k]
            if task.done() and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None:
                results.append(task.result())
            elif k in self.partial:
                results.append(self.partial[k])
        return ErpResearch(requirements=results, materials=self.records(),
                           seconds=round(time.monotonic() - (self.started_at or time.monotonic()), 1))

    def material(self, number: str, link: str = "") -> asyncio.Task:
        """One detail worker per material, shared when several requirements inspect the same one."""
        if number not in self.materials:
            self.materials[number] = asyncio.create_task(self._material(number, link))
        return self.materials[number]

    async def _material(self, number: str, link: str) -> MaterialRecord | None:
        views: dict[str, str] = {}
        record = None
        focus = ""
        name = f"{self.site['siteId']}:{number}"
        for attempt in range(2):  # a second pass, keeping what was read, when facts are missing
            if self.left() < (READ_SECONDS + 30 if not attempt else MATERIAL_SECONDS + 30):
                break  # a second pass only with time for it; the first record stays either way
            coverage = None
            async with self._slot():
                session = await self._worker_tab(number if not attempt else f"{number}+", link or None)
                if session is None:
                    continue
                name = session.name
                try:
                    _keep_views(session, views)
                    if link and session.view:  # the record view it opened on, kept for the reader too
                        views[session.page.url] = _strip_refs(session.view)
                    until = self._until(READ_SECONDS)
                    coverage, _ = await run_worker(session, DETAIL_GOAL.format(material=number, focus=focus),
                                                   Coverage, deadline=until, max_steps=steps(until, 6, 18),
                                                   tools=(open_pages,), **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
                finally:
                    await self._close(session)
            corpus = _corpus(views)
            self.trace.event(name, "material_read", views=len(views), chars=len(corpus),
                             not_found=coverage.not_found if coverage else "worker stopped")
            try:
                seen = await asyncio.wait_for(_read_material(number, corpus, self.trace, name),
                                              max(5.0, self.left() - CHOOSE_SECONDS))
            except Exception as error:
                self.trace.event(name, "material_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
                continue
            record = _material_record(seen)
            missing = incomplete(record)
            if not missing:
                break
            record.problems.append(f"missing after pass {attempt + 1}: {', '.join(missing)}")
            focus = f"\nStill missing from the views read so far: {', '.join(missing)}. Open the views for these."
        if record is not None and record.material_number != number:
            record.problems.append(f"reader reported material {record.material_number} for {number}")
        return record

    def start(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Research one requirement in the background (e.g. as soon as the specification yields it)."""
        if self.started_at is None:
            self.started_at = time.monotonic()
        if req.requirement_id not in self.tasks:
            self.tasks[req.requirement_id] = asyncio.create_task(self.requirement(req))
        return self.tasks[req.requirement_id]

    async def collect(self) -> ErpResearch:
        """Wait for every started requirement and the materials they inspect (each ends by the deadline)."""
        results = []
        for k in sorted(self.tasks, key=calc.position_key):
            try:
                results.append(await self.tasks[k])
            except Exception as error:  # one failed requirement must not cost the others
                results.append(RequirementResearch(requirement_id=k, problems=[
                    f"research failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}"]))
        return ErpResearch(requirements=results, materials=self.records(),
                           seconds=round(time.monotonic() - (self.started_at or time.monotonic()), 1))

    def records(self) -> dict[str, MaterialRecord]:
        """Every material record finished so far."""
        out = {}
        for number, task in self.materials.items():
            if not task.done() or task.cancelled():
                continue
            if task.exception() is not None:
                self.trace.event("erp", "material_failed", material=number, error=type(task.exception()).__name__)
            elif task.result() is not None:
                out[number] = task.result()
        return out

    async def research(self, requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement]) -> ErpResearch:
        for req in requirements:
            self.start(req)
        return await self.collect()


class MaterialChoice(BaseModel):
    material_number: str = Field(description="The chosen material number, or '' if none of them qualifies")
    why: str = Field(description="In a few words")


CHOOSE_MATERIAL = """\
You choose the ERP material for one tender requirement. Only an active (released) material qualifies, and its
bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification must all equal the requirement exactly (numbers as numbers;
no certification required means the material must name none). Blocked materials never qualify. If none
qualifies, answer ''."""

# The choice is a short decision over records already read, and `evidence.check_choice` sends a wrong one back with
# the reason, so it runs thinking off with a short timeout (RESEARCH_CHOOSE_THINKING=1 turns thinking on).
CHOOSE_THINKING = os.environ.get("RESEARCH_CHOOSE_THINKING", "0") == "1"


def _describe(number: str, record: MaterialRecord, research: RequirementResearch) -> str:
    attrs = merged_attributes(record, research)
    shown = ", ".join(f"{k} {attrs[k]}" for k in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")
                      if k in attrs)
    return f"- {number}: status {record.status}, active={record.active}; {shown}"


async def choose_material(req: EffectiveRequirement, research: RequirementResearch,
                          materials: dict[str, MaterialRecord], trace: Trace | None = None
                          ) -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
    """The model picks the material from the inspected candidates; `evidence.check_choice` validates the exact
    match and status and sends a wrong choice back with the reason."""
    if req.stroke is None:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: stroke pending ({'; '.join(req.pending)})"]
    if not materials:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no material could be inspected"]
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=MaterialChoice, instructions=CHOOSE_MATERIAL,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(CHOOSE_THINKING, timeout=llm.env_seconds("LLM_CHOOSE_TIMEOUT", 30.0)),
                  retries=3)

    @agent.output_validator
    def _valid(out: MaterialChoice) -> MaterialChoice:
        problem = check_choice(req, research, materials, out.material_number.strip() or None)
        if problem:
            if trace:
                trace.event("choose", "choice_refused", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=out.material_number,
                            problem=problem)
            raise ModelRetry(problem)
        return out

    listing = "\n".join(_describe(n, r, research) for n, r in materials.items())
    prompt = f"Requirement {req.requirement_id}: {_want(req)}.\nInspected ERP materials:\n{listing}"
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        choice = (await agent.run(prompt)).output
    except Exception as error:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no valid choice ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})"]
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "material", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=choice.material_number,
                    why=choice.why, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))
    return choice.material_number.strip() or None, []


RESELECT_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("RESELECT_SECONDS", "50"))  # below the orchestrator's own cap


async def reselect(requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement], erp: ErpResearch, trace: Trace | None = None,
                   budget: float = RESELECT_SECONDS) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """
    Choose again once reserves or amendments have resolved the requirements (the ERP stage inspected every hit,
    so no further browsing is needed). A choice the ERP stage's model made that still passes `check_choice` for the
    final requirement stands without another call; the others are asked in parallel within `budget` seconds. A
    requirement whose choice fails or runs out of time gets None and a problem on its research, so its position is
    left out rather than taken for "no material" (no_bid); the choices made by then are kept.
    """
    by_id = {r.requirement_id: r for r in erp.requirements}
    chosen: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    asked: list[str] = []

    async def one(req: EffectiveRequirement) -> None:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is None:
            return
        materials = {n: erp.materials[n] for n in research.inspected if n in erp.materials}
        if (req.stroke is not None and research.selected in materials
                and check_choice(req, research, materials, research.selected) is None):
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = research.selected
            return
        if req.stroke is not None:  # a stroke that was pending in the ERP stage is known now
            research.problems = [p for p in research.problems if "stroke pending" not in p]
        asked.append(req.requirement_id)
        number, problems = await choose_material(req, research, materials, trace)
        research.problems += [p for p in problems if p not in research.problems]
        chosen[req.requirement_id] = number

    started = time.monotonic()

self.partial: dict[str, RequirementResearch] = {}  # requirement -> research whose search has finished

    def left(self) -> float:
        return float("inf") if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - time.monotonic()

    def _until(self, reserve: float) -> float | None:
        return None if self.deadline is None else self.deadline - reserve

    def warm_up(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Sign in and get past entry gates once (a model handles gates the helpers cannot), e.g. while the
        specification is still being read."""
        if self.ready is None:
            self.ready = asyncio.create_task(self._warm_up())
        return self.ready

    async def _warm_up(self) -> None:
        async with self.gate:
            session = await self._worker_tab("start")
            if session is None:  # the workers' own tabs try again
                return
            try:
                await self._pass_gate(session)
            finally:
                await self._close(session)

    async def _pass_gate(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """A model gets the tab past the sign-in / notice gate; then the start address shows where a signed-in
        tab lands (`home`). Called with `gate` held."""
        if not await self._at_home(session):  # the page it is on is a gate (a later drop may land there again)
            self.gate_paths.add(urlparse(session.page.url).path or "/")
        await run_worker(session, GATE_GOAL, Ready, deadline=self._until(0), max_steps=8,
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        self.passes += 1
        async with session.lock:
            await session._goto(self.site["url"])
        await session.look()
        if not session.view.startswith("(") and not await self._signin_form(session):
            self.home = urlparse(session.page.url).path or "/"
        self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    @staticmethod
    async def _signin_form(session: SiteSession) -> bool:
        try:
            return bool(await session.page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count())
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def _at_home(self, session: SiteSession) -> bool:
        return bool(self.home) and (urlparse(session.page.url).path or "/") == self.home \
            and not await self._signin_form(session)

    async def _at_gate(self, session: SiteSession) -> bool:
        return (urlparse(session.page.url).path or "/") in self.gate_paths or await self._signin_form(session)

    async def recover(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """The tab did not reach its view (session dropped, entry gate): get past the gate once for all tabs."""
        if not await self._at_gate(session):  # e.g. a view that redirects elsewhere: not a dropped session
            return
        passes = self.passes
        async with self.gate:
            if self.passes != passes:  # another tab passed the gate while this one waited
                return
            self.trace.event(session.name, "erp_recover", url=session.page.url)
            await self._pass_gate(session)

    async def ensure(self) -> None:
        """Before a worker starts: the session signed in. After the ERP sat idle (it drops idle sessions), one tab
        checks it and passes the gate again if needed, before the other workers pile in and sign in at once."""
        await self.warm_up()
        if self.busy or time.monotonic() - self.active_at < self.idle_limit:
            return
        async with self.checking:
            if self.busy or time.monotonic() - self.active_at < self.idle_limit:
                return  # another worker checked meanwhile
            session = await self._worker_tab("check")  # a tab that does not land at home passes the gate again
            if session is not None:
                await self._close(session)
            self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    def _guard_login(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """Sign-ins one tab at a time; a tab that waited while another signed in first reloads, since the shared
        context may already be signed in again."""
        login = session._login

        async def serialised(page: Page) -> bool:
            if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                return False
            signins = self.signins
            async with self.signin:
                if self.signins != signins:
                    try:
                        await page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    if not await page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").count():
                        session.events.append("another tab signed in; reloaded")
                        return True
                done = await login(page)
                if done:
                    self.signins += 1
                    await asyncio.sleep(1.0)  # let the sign-in land before the next tab acts
                return done

        session._login = serialised  # type: ignore[method-assign]

    async def _tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession:
        """A tab in the shared context (a reused one when a finished worker left it); `tag` names it in the
        trace. With `url`, the tab opens that link target, else the start address."""
        session = SiteSession({**self.site, "siteId": f"{self.site['siteId']}:{tag}"}, self.context, self.trace)
        self._guard_login(session)
        session.recover = lambda: self.recover(session)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        page = None
        while self.idle_pages and page is None:
            candidate = self.idle_pages.pop()
            page = None if candidate.is_closed() else candidate
        if page is not None:
            session.scripted = True  # the context already has the popup closer
            session._watch(page)
            if not url:
                async with session.lock:
                    await session._goto(self.site["url"])
                await session.look()
        else:
            async with self.opening:
                await session.start()
        if url:
            await self.open(session, url)
        elif self.home and not await self._at_home(session):  # dropped: one tab passes the gate for all
            await self.recover(session)
            async with session.lock:
                await session._goto(self.site["url"])
            await session.look()
        return session

    @contextlib.asynccontextmanager
    async def _slot(self):
        """A tab slot for one worker, with the session checked first."""
        await self.ensure()
        async with self.tabs:
            self.busy += 1
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                self.busy -= 1
                self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    async def open(self, session: SiteSession, url: str) -> bool:
        """Open a link target a model reported, with the same rule as the goto tool: only on this website. A tab
        that lands elsewhere (sign-in, entry gate) recovers once and opens it again."""
        target = on_site(self.site, url)
        if target is None:
            self.trace.event(session.name, "link_refused", url=url)
            return False
        for attempt in range(2):
            async with session.lock:
                await session._goto(target)
            await session.look()
            landed, wanted = urlparse(session.page.url), urlparse(target)
            if (landed.path, landed.query) == (wanted.path, wanted.query):
                session.__dict__.setdefault("opened", set()).add(target)
                return True
            if not attempt:
                await self.recover(session)
        return False

    async def _close(self, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        """Hand the worker's tab back for reuse (popups it opened are closed)."""
        kept = False
        for page in session.pages:
            try:
                page.remove_listener("dialog", session._on_dialog)
                page.remove_listener("popup", session._on_popup)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if not kept and not page.is_closed() and len(self.idle_pages) < 8:
                self.idle_pages.append(page)
                kept = True
                continue
            try:
                await page.close()
            except Exception:  # already gone
                continue

    async def _worker_tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession | None:
        try:  # a tab that does not open costs this attempt, not the research
            return await self._tab(tag, url)
        except Exception as error:
            self.trace.event("erp", "tab_failed", tag=tag, error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return None

    async def requirement(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> RequirementResearch:
        out = RequirementResearch(requirement_id=req.requirement_id)
        report = None
        until = self._until(MATERIAL_SECONDS)
        for attempt in range(2):  # retry once: the ERP sometimes drops the session mid-search
            if self.left() < MATERIAL_SECONDS + 20:
                break
            async with self._slot():
                session = await self._worker_tab(req.requirement_id if not attempt else f"{req.requirement_id}+")
                if session is None:
                    continue
                views = _keep_views(session)
                try:
                    report, _ = await run_worker(
                        session, SEARCH_GOAL.format(group=req.catalog_group), SearchReport,
                        deadline=until, max_steps=steps(until, 6, 16), tools=(site_tools.search, site_tools.collect),
                        **_worker_kwargs(notes=False))
                    if report is None:  # stopped (steps, time): the hit list it ended on may still be there
                        report = await _salvage_search(session, views, req.catalog_group)
                finally:
                    await self._close(session)
            if report is not None:
                break
        if report is None:
            out.problems.append("search worker returned no result")
            return out
        out.search_term = report.search_term
        out.candidates = [Candidate(material_number=c.material_number.strip(), link=c.link.strip(),
                                    bore=_num(c.bore), stroke=_num(c.stroke), pressure=_num(c.pressure),
                                    mounting=c.mounting, certification=c.certification)
                          for c in report.candidates]
        # every hit of the model's search is inspected (the rules cap a usable search at 20 hits); which one fits is
        # the model's choice below, once the details are known
        out.inspected = list(dict.fromkeys(c.material_number for c in out.candidates))[:MAX_INSPECT]
        if len(out.candidates) > MAX_INSPECT:
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.candidates)} hits, inspected the first {MAX_INSPECT}")
        # until the choice below is made, the research stands with its hits marked unfinished (so_far): a later
        # choice can still find the exact match among the materials read, and no match omits the position
        out.problems.append(UNFINISHED)
        self.partial[req.requirement_id] = out
        links = {c.material_number: c.link for c in out.candidates}
        tasks = [self.material(number, links.get(number, "")) for number in out.inspected]
        # material workers stop early enough for their reader; a record still open at the deadline is left out
        # and the choice is made over the ones that are complete
        done = set()
        if tasks:
            done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=max(1.0, self.left() - CHOOSE_SECONDS))
        materials = {}
        for task in tasks:
            if task in done and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None and task.result() is not None:
                materials[task.result().material_number] = task.result()
        if len(materials) < len(out.inspected):
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.inspected) - len(materials)} of {len(out.inspected)} materials not read")
        try:
            out.selected, problems = await asyncio.wait_for(choose_material(req, out, materials, self.trace),
                                                            max(1.0, self.left() - 2))
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            out.selected, problems = None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no choice before the research deadline"]
        out.problems = [p for p in out.problems if p != UNFINISHED] + problems
        return out

    def so_far(self) -> ErpResearch:
        """What the ERP stage has at the deadline: finished requirements, the ones whose search finished (hits
        marked unfinished), and every finished material record."""
        results = []
        for k in sorted(self.tasks, key=calc.position_key):
            task = self.tasks[k]
            if task.done() and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None:
                results.append(task.result())
            elif k in self.partial:
                results.append(self.partial[k])
        return ErpResearch(requirements=results, materials=self.records(),
                           seconds=round(time.monotonic() - (self.started_at or time.monotonic()), 1))

    def material(self, number: str, link: str = "") -> asyncio.Task:
        """One detail worker per material, shared when several requirements inspect the same one."""
        if number not in self.materials:
            self.materials[number] = asyncio.create_task(self._material(number, link))
        return self.materials[number]

    async def _material(self, number: str, link: str) -> MaterialRecord | None:
        views: dict[str, str] = {}
        record = None
        focus = ""
        name = f"{self.site['siteId']}:{number}"
        for attempt in range(2):  # a second pass, keeping what was read, when facts are missing
            if self.left() < (READ_SECONDS + 30 if not attempt else MATERIAL_SECONDS + 30):
                break  # a second pass only with time for it; the first record stays either way
            coverage = None
            async with self._slot():
                session = await self._worker_tab(number if not attempt else f"{number}+", link or None)
                if session is None:
                    continue
                name = session.name
                try:
                    _keep_views(session, views)
                    if link and session.view:  # the record view it opened on, kept for the reader too
                        views[session.page.url] = _strip_refs(session.view)
                    until = self._until(READ_SECONDS)
                    coverage, _ = await run_worker(session, DETAIL_GOAL.format(material=number, focus=focus),
                                                   Coverage, deadline=until, max_steps=steps(until, 6, 18),
                                                   tools=(open_pages,), **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
                finally:
                    await self._close(session)
            corpus = _corpus(views)
            self.trace.event(name, "material_read", views=len(views), chars=len(corpus),
                             not_found=coverage.not_found if coverage else "worker stopped")
            try:
                seen = await asyncio.wait_for(_read_material(number, corpus, self.trace, name),
                                              max(5.0, self.left() - CHOOSE_SECONDS))
            except Exception as error:
                self.trace.event(name, "material_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
                continue
            record = _material_record(seen)
            missing = incomplete(record)
            if not missing:
                break
            record.problems.append(f"missing after pass {attempt + 1}: {', '.join(missing)}")
            focus = f"\nStill missing from the views read so far: {', '.join(missing)}. Open the views for these."
        if record is not None and record.material_number != number:
            record.problems.append(f"reader reported material {record.material_number} for {number}")
        return record

    def start(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Research one requirement in the background (e.g. as soon as the specification yields it)."""
        if self.started_at is None:
            self.started_at = time.monotonic()
        if req.requirement_id not in self.tasks:
            self.tasks[req.requirement_id] = asyncio.create_task(self.requirement(req))
        return self.tasks[req.requirement_id]

    async def collect(self) -> ErpResearch:
        """Wait for every started requirement and the materials they inspect (each ends by the deadline)."""
        results = []
        for k in sorted(self.tasks, key=calc.position_key):
            try:
                results.append(await self.tasks[k])
            except Exception as error:  # one failed requirement must not cost the others
                results.append(RequirementResearch(requirement_id=k, problems=[
                    f"research failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}"]))
        return ErpResearch(requirements=results, materials=self.records(),
                           seconds=round(time.monotonic() - (self.started_at or time.monotonic()), 1))

    def records(self) -> dict[str, MaterialRecord]:
        """Every material record finished so far."""
        out = {}
        for number, task in self.materials.items():
            if not task.done() or task.cancelled():
                continue
            if task.exception() is not None:
                self.trace.event("erp", "material_failed", material=number, error=type(task.exception()).__name__)
            elif task.result() is not None:
                out[number] = task.result()
        return out

    async def research(self, requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement]) -> ErpResearch:
        for req in requirements:
            self.start(req)
        return await self.collect()


class MaterialChoice(BaseModel):
    material_number: str = Field(description="The chosen material number, or '' if none of them qualifies")
    why: str = Field(description="In a few words")


CHOOSE_MATERIAL = """\
You choose the ERP material for one tender requirement. Only an active (released) material qualifies, and its
bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification must all equal the requirement exactly (numbers as numbers;
no certification required means the material must name none). Blocked materials never qualify. If none
qualifies, answer ''."""

# The choice is a short decision over records already read, and `evidence.check_choice` sends a wrong one back with
# the reason, so it runs thinking off with a short timeout (RESEARCH_CHOOSE_THINKING=1 turns thinking on).
CHOOSE_THINKING = os.environ.get("RESEARCH_CHOOSE_THINKING", "0") == "1"


def _describe(number: str, record: MaterialRecord, research: RequirementResearch) -> str:
    attrs = merged_attributes(record, research)
    shown = ", ".join(f"{k} {attrs[k]}" for k in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")
                      if k in attrs)
    return f"- {number}: status {record.status}, active={record.active}; {shown}"


async def choose_material(req: EffectiveRequirement, research: RequirementResearch,
                          materials: dict[str, MaterialRecord], trace: Trace | None = None
                          ) -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
    """The model picks the material from the inspected candidates; `evidence.check_choice` validates the exact
    match and status and sends a wrong choice back with the reason."""
    if req.stroke is None:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: stroke pending ({'; '.join(req.pending)})"]
    if not materials:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no material could be inspected"]
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=MaterialChoice, instructions=CHOOSE_MATERIAL,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(CHOOSE_THINKING, timeout=llm.env_seconds("LLM_CHOOSE_TIMEOUT", 30.0)),
                  retries=3)

    @agent.output_validator
    def _valid(out: MaterialChoice) -> MaterialChoice:
        problem = check_choice(req, research, materials, out.material_number.strip() or None)
        if problem:
            if trace:
                trace.event("choose", "choice_refused", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=out.material_number,
                            problem=problem)
            raise ModelRetry(problem)
        return out

    listing = "\n".join(_describe(n, r, research) for n, r in materials.items())
    prompt = f"Requirement {req.requirement_id}: {_want(req)}.\nInspected ERP materials:\n{listing}"
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        choice = (await agent.run(prompt)).output
    except Exception as error:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no valid choice ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})"]
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "material", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=choice.material_number,
                    why=choice.why, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))
    return choice.material_number.strip() or None, []


RESELECT_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("RESELECT_SECONDS", "50"))  # below the orchestrator's own cap


async def reselect(requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement], erp: ErpResearch, trace: Trace | None = None,
                   budget: float = RESELECT_SECONDS) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """
    Choose again once reserves or amendments have resolved the requirements (the ERP stage inspected every hit,
    so no further browsing is needed). A choice the ERP stage's model made that still passes `check_choice` for the
    final requirement stands without another call; the others are asked in parallel within `budget` seconds. A
    requirement whose choice fails or runs out of time gets None and a problem on its research, so its position is
    left out rather than taken for "no material" (no_bid); the choices made by then are kept.
    """
    by_id = {r.requirement_id: r for r in erp.requirements}
    chosen: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    asked: list[str] = []

    async def one(req: EffectiveRequirement) -> None:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is None:
            return
        materials = {n: erp.materials[n] for n in research.inspected if n in erp.materials}
        if (req.stroke is not None and research.selected in materials
                and check_choice(req, research, materials, research.selected) is None):
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = research.selected
            return
        if req.stroke is not None:  # a stroke that was pending in the ERP stage is known now
            research.problems = [p for p in research.problems if "stroke pending" not in p]
        asked.append(req.requirement_id)
        number, problems = await choose_material(req, research, materials, trace)
        research.problems += [p for p in problems if p not in research.problems]
        chosen[req.requirement_id] = number

    started = time.monotonic()
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(one(r)) for r in requirements]
    if tasks:
        _, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=budget)
        for task in pending:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
    for req in requirements:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is not None and req.requirement_id not in chosen:
            research.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id}: final material choice not made in time")
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = None
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "reselect", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), asked=asked, chosen=chosen)
    return chosen

   228	async def open_and_keep(session: SiteSession, urls: list[str], kept: list[str]) -> list[str]:
   229	    """Open each chosen URL in a temporary tab of the session's browser context, side by side, and keep its text."""
   230	
   231	    async def one(url: str) -> str:
   232	        tab = SiteSession(session.site, session.context, session.trace)
   233	        page = await session.context.new_page()
   234	        tab._watch(page)
   235	        try:
   236	            await tab._goto(url)
   237	            view = await tab.look()
   238	            # An embedded document that did not render in place (e.g. a lazy reading pane) is part of the chosen
   239	            # page: open it on its own and add its text.
   240	            for src in EMPTY_FRAME.findall(view)[:3]:
   241	                await tab._goto(urljoin(url, src))
   242	                view += f"\n[frame {src} opened]\n" + await tab.look()
   243	            return view
   244	        finally:
   245	            await page.close()

   249	    for view in good:

   259	def keep_tool(kept: list[str]):

   262	    async def keep_pages(ctx: RunContext[Deps], targets: list[str]) -> str:
   263	        """Open these links and keep each page for reading afterwards: give each link's target (the "-> ..." part)
   264	        or its ref from the latest view. Pass every page you want at once; they open side by side. Your own tab
   265	        stays where it is."""
   266	        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
   267	        host = urlparse(session.site["url"]).netloc
   268	
   269	        def on_a_page(target: str) -> bool:  # chosen from a view, not made up
   270	            url = urlparse(urljoin(session.page.url, target))
   271	            local = url.path + (f"?{url.query}" if url.query else "")
   272	            return target in session.seen or f"-> {local}" in session.seen or f"-> {url.geturl()}" in session.seen
   273	
   274	        links = LINK.findall(session.view)
   275	        hrefs = {ref: href for ref, _, href in links}  # a link's ref from the latest view stands for its target
   276	        targets = [hrefs.get(t.strip(), t.strip()) for t in targets]
   277	        shown = [t for t in targets if t and not REF.fullmatch(t) and on_a_page(t)]
   278	        unknown = [t for t in targets if t.strip() and t.strip() not in shown]
   279	        urls = list(dict.fromkeys(urljoin(session.page.url, t) for t in shown))
   280	        urls = [u for u in urls if urlparse(u).netloc == host][:25]
   281	        good = await open_and_keep(session, urls, kept)
   282	        session.trace.event(session.name, "keep_pages", targets=urls, unknown=unknown, kept=len(good))
   283	        answer = f"Kept {len(good)} of {len(urls)} page(s):\n{_heads(good)}"
   284	        if unknown:
   285	            listing = "\n".join(f"  {ref}: {href}" for ref, _, href in links[:40])
   286	            answer += (f"\nNot opened, these targets appear on no page you have seen: {unknown[:10]}. Use link "
   287	                       f"targets exactly as the views show them. Links in the latest view:\n{listing}")
   288	        return answer

   368	def _numbers(text: str) -> set[Decimal]:
   369	    found: set[Decimal] = set()
   370	    for token in re.findall(r"\d[\d.,]*", text):
   371	        token = token.rstrip(".,")
   372	        for candidate in (token.replace(",", "."), token.replace(".", "").replace(",", "."), token.replace(",", "")):
   373	            try:
   374	                found.add(Decimal(candidate))
   375	            except InvalidOperation:
   376	                pass
   377	    return found

   380	def ungrounded(record: BaseModel, text: str, skip: tuple[str, ...] = ("date",)) -> list[str]:
   381	    """Values in a record (numbers, keys) that the source text does not contain; dates are not checked."""
   382	    numbers = _numbers(text)
   383	    flat = " ".join(text.split())
   384	    missing: list[str] = []
   385	
   386	    def check(value, name: str) -> None:
   387	        if name in skip or value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, datetime)):
   388	            return
   389	        if isinstance(value, BaseModel):
   390	            for k, v in value:
   391	                check(v, k)
   392	        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
   393	            for v in value:
   394	                check(v, name)
   395	        elif isinstance(value, dict):
   396	            for k, v in value.items():
   397	                check(v, str(k))
   398	        elif isinstance(value, (int, Decimal, float)):
   399	            if Decimal(str(value)) not in numbers:
   400	                missing.append(f"{name}={value}")
   401	        elif isinstance(value, str) and any(c.isdigit() for c in value):
   402	            if " ".join(value.split()) not in flat and not (_numbers(value) and _numbers(value) <= numbers):
   403	                missing.append(f"{name}={value!r}")
   404	
   405	    check(record, "")
   406	    return missing

   458	
   459	    With `qa_session` (a second tab of the website) the documents and the Q&A are worked side by side, each by its
   460	    own worker. `on_facts(facts)` gets the positions with their original quantities as soon as they are read, so a
   461	    deadline that comes before the Q&A still leaves them; the returned facts include the Q&A.
   462	    """
   463	    started = time.monotonic()
   464	    if qa_session is None:
   465	        return await _research_tender_one(session, reference, scenario, deadline=deadline, on_facts=on_facts)
   466	    collected = Collected()

   470	        await run_worker(session, _positions_goal(reference), Summary, deadline=deadline,
   471	                         max_steps=steps_for(14, deadline), thinking=False, grounded=False,
   472	                         tools=(keep_tool(documents),))

   477	                         max_steps=steps_for(14, deadline), thinking=False, grounded=False,
   478	                         tools=(paging_tool(collected),))
   479	        return await read_qa(collected.pages or [qa_session.seen], reference)
   480	
   481	    qa_task = asyncio.create_task(qa_part())
   482	    try:
   483	        try:
   484	            positions = await positions_part()
   485	        except Exception as error:
   486	            session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_positions_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"[:200])
   487	            positions = TenderPositions(positions=[])
   488	        if not positions.positions:  # the Q&A worker passed the tender's pages too
   489	            await asyncio.wait([qa_task])

   491	                positions = await read_positions(qa_session.seen, reference)

   493	                positions = TenderPositions(positions=[])

   495	            session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_failed")

   498	        if on_facts is not None and not qa_task.done():
   499	            early = resolve_tender(positions.positions, QaRecords(), scenario, fmt)
   500	            session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_positions", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
   501	                                positions=[p.position for p in early.positions])

   504	            qa = await qa_task
   505	        except Exception as error:
   506	            session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_qa_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"[:200])

   516	        on_facts(facts)
   517	    return facts

165	   165	    def add(self, view: str) -> bool:

175	   175	        return True

190	   190	    """A tool that pages through the result set the model is looking at, by repeating the control it names."""

192	   192	    async def collect_pages(ctx: RunContext[Deps], next_ref: str) -> str:
193	   193	        """Collect the whole list you are looking at: give the ref of its "next page" or "load more" control. The
194	   194	        control is clicked until the list ends; every page is kept for reading afterwards. Call it once, on the
195	   195	        list's first page."""
196	   196	        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
197	   197	        control = _control(session.view, next_ref)
198	   198	        if control is None:
199	   199	            return f"No control {next_ref} in the latest view; use a ref from the latest view."
200	   200	        kind, name = control
201	   201	        collected.add(session.view)
202	   202	        ref, pages = next_ref, 1
203	   203	        for _ in range(MAX_PAGES):
204	   204	            before = _normal(session.view)
205	   205	            await session.act("click", ref, _click)
206	   206	            for _ in range(4):  # a list inside a frame can update a moment after the click settled
207	   207	                if _normal(session.view) != before:
208	   208	                    break
209	   209	                await asyncio.sleep(0.7)
210	   210	                await session.look()
211	   211	            if not collected.add(session.view):
212	   212	                break
213	   213	            pages += 1
214	   214	            same = [r for r, k, n in REF_LINE.findall(session.view) if k == kind and n == name]
215	   215	            if not same:
216	   216	                break
217	   217	            ref = same[0]
218	   218	        session.trace.event(session.name, "collect_pages", control=name, pages=len(collected.pages))
219	   219	        session.trace.event(session.name, "collected", quiet=True, pages=collected.pages)
220	   220	        text = collected.text
221	   221	        if len(text) > MAX_RETURN:
222	   222	            text = text[:MAX_RETURN] + f"\n[... {len(text) - MAX_RETURN} more characters, kept for reading]"
223	   223	        return f"Collected {pages} page(s) of this list; they are kept for reading. The whole list:\n\n{text}"
224	   224	
225	   225	    return collect_pages

228	   228	async def open_and_keep(session: SiteSession, urls: list[str], kept: list[str]) -> list[str]:
229	   229	    """Open each chosen URL in a temporary tab of the session's browser context, side by side, and keep its text."""
230	   230	
231	   231	    async def one(url: str) -> str:
232	   232	        tab = SiteSession(session.site, session.context, session.trace)
233	   233	        page = await session.context.new_page()
234	   234	        tab._watch(page)
235	   235	        try:
236	   236	            await tab._goto(url)
237	   237	            view = await tab.look()
238	   238	            # An embedded document that did not render in place (e.g. a lazy reading pane) is part of the chosen
239	   239	            # page: open it on its own and add its text.
240	   240	            for src in EMPTY_FRAME.findall(view)[:3]:
241	   241	                await tab._goto(urljoin(url, src))
242	   242	                view += f"\n[frame {src} opened]\n" + await tab.look()

244	   244	        finally:
245	   245	            await page.close()

247	   247	    views = await asyncio.gather(*(one(u) for u in urls), return_exceptions=True)
248	   248	    good = [v for v in views if isinstance(v, str)]
249	   249	    for view in good:
250	   250	        kept.append(view)
251	   251	        session.seen += "\n" + view

259	   259	def keep_tool(kept: list[str]):
260	   260	    """A tool that opens link targets the model chose, each in a temporary tab, and keeps their page text."""
261	   261	
262	   262	    async def keep_pages(ctx: RunContext[Deps], targets: list[str]) -> str:
263	   263	        """Open these links and keep each page for reading afterwards: give each link's target (the "-> ..." part)
264	   264	        or its ref from the latest view. Pass every page you want at once; they open side by side. Your own tab
265	   265	        stays where it is."""
266	   266	        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
267	   267	        host = urlparse(session.site["url"]).netloc
268	   268	
269	   269	        def on_a_page(target: str) -> bool:  # chosen from a view, not made up
270	   270	            url = urlparse(urljoin(session.page.url, target))
271	   271	            local = url.path + (f"?{url.query}" if url.query else "")
272	   272	            return target in session.seen or f"-> {local}" in session.seen or f"-> {url.geturl()}" in session.seen
273	   273	
274	   274	        links = LINK.findall(session.view)
275	   275	        hrefs = {ref: href for ref, _, href in links}  # a link's ref from the latest view stands for its target
276	   276	        targets = [hrefs.get(t.strip(), t.strip()) for t in targets]
277	   277	        shown = [t for t in targets if t and not REF.fullmatch(t) and on_a_page(t)]
278	   278	        unknown = [t for t in targets if t.strip() and t.strip() not in shown]
279	   279	        urls = list(dict.fromkeys(urljoin(session.page.url, t) for t in shown))
280	   280	        urls = [u for u in urls if urlparse(u).netloc == host][:25]
281	   281	        good = await open_and_keep(session, urls, kept)
282	   282	        session.trace.event(session.name, "keep_pages", targets=urls, unknown=unknown, kept=len(good))
283	   283	        answer = f"Kept {len(good)} of {len(urls)} page(s):\n{_heads(good)}"
284	   284	        if unknown:
285	   285	            listing = "\n".join(f"  {ref}: {href}" for ref, _, href in links[:40])
286	   286	            answer += (f"\nNot opened, these targets appear on no page you have seen: {unknown[:10]}. Use link "
287	   287	                       f"targets exactly as the views show them. Links in the latest view:\n{listing}")
288	   288	        return answer
289	   289	
290	   290	    return keep_pages

349	   349	POSITIONS_INSTRUCTIONS = """\
350	   350	You read the documents of a public tender and list its positions exactly as written: position number,
351	   351	short text, quantity, unit and the requirement id of the buyer's specification the position refers to. Use the
352	   352	ORIGINAL quantities the tender documents were published with; later changes are not part of this. If several documents list the positions, they should agree; prefer a table of the bill of
353	   353	quantities. List every position once."""
354	   354

356	   356	QA_INSTRUCTIONS = """\
357	   357	You read the bidder Q&A of a public tender and record every fact it states, exactly as written.
358	   358	The answers may be shown out of number order (sorted by date); each answer has a number and a date. Use the
359	   359	answer's own date (prefer the UTC timestamp shown, e.g. in a tooltip). One answer can carry several facts: record
360	   360	each of them, with that answer's number and date. Record what the answers say; do not resolve conflicts, do not
361	   361	skip older or superseded answers, and do not invent facts for positions an answer does not name. Statements that
362	   362	a position is NOT a member of a pool or plan mean no membership: record nothing for them. An answer that withdraws
363	   363	(zieht zurück) an earlier answer is a withdrawal of that earlier answer's number. Technical amendments name a
364	   364	specification revision and a requirement: record one amendment per changed attribute. Copy numbers exactly as
365	   365	written; do not convert them. The same answer can appear on two page views; record it once. Ignore page furniture (navigation, notices, buttons)."""

368	   368	def _numbers(text: str) -> set[Decimal]:
369	   369	    found: set[Decimal] = set()
370	   370	    for token in re.findall(r"\d[\d.,]*", text):
371	   371	        token = token.rstrip(".,")
372	   372	        for candidate in (token.replace(",", "."), token.replace(".", "").replace(",", "."), token.replace(",", "")):
373	   373	            try:
374	   374	                found.add(Decimal(candidate))
375	   375	            except InvalidOperation:
376	   376	                pass
377	   377	    return found

380	   380	def ungrounded(record: BaseModel, text: str, skip: tuple[str, ...] = ("date",)) -> list[str]:
381	   381	    """Values in a record (numbers, keys) that the source text does not contain; dates are not checked."""
382	   382	    numbers = _numbers(text)
383	   383	    flat = " ".join(text.split())
384	   384	    missing: list[str] = []
385	   385	
386	   386	    def check(value, name: str) -> None:
387	   387	        if name in skip or value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, datetime)):
388	   388	            return
389	   389	        if isinstance(value, BaseModel):
390	   390	            for k, v in value:
391	   391	                check(v, k)
392	   392	        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
393	   393	            for v in value:
394	   394	                check(v, name)
395	   395	        elif isinstance(value, dict):
396	   396	            for k, v in value.items():
397	   397	                check(v, str(k))
398	   398	        elif isinstance(value, (int, Decimal, float)):
399	   399	            if Decimal(str(value)) not in numbers:
400	   400	                missing.append(f"{name}={value}")
401	   401	        elif isinstance(value, str) and any(c.isdigit() for c in value):
402	   402	            if " ".join(value.split()) not in flat and not (_numbers(value) and _numbers(value) <= numbers):
403	   403	                missing.append(f"{name}={value!r}")
404	   404	
405	   405	    check(record, "")
406	   406	    return missing

453	   453	async def research_tender(session: SiteSession, reference: str, scenario: datetime, *,
454	   454	                          deadline: float | None = None, qa_session: SiteSession | None = None,
455	   455	                          on_facts=None) -> TenderFacts | None:
456	   456	    """
457	   457	    Positions and Q&A of the tender, resolved per position. None when no positions were found.
458	   458	
459	   459	    With `qa_session` (a second tab of the website) the documents and the Q&A are worked side by side, each by its
460	   460	    own worker. `on_facts(facts)` gets the positions with their original quantities as soon as they are read, so a
461	   461	    deadline that comes before the Q&A still leaves them; the returned facts include the Q&A.
462	   462	    """
463	   463	    started = time.monotonic()
464	   464	    if qa_session is None:
465	   465	        return await _research_tender_one(session, reference, scenario, deadline=deadline, on_facts=on_facts)
466	   466	    collected = Collected()
467	   467	    documents: list[str] = []
468	   468	
469	   469	    async def positions_part() -> TenderPositions:
470	   470	        await run_worker(session, _positions_goal(reference), Summary, deadline=deadline,
471	   471	                         max_steps=steps_for(14, deadline), thinking=False, grounded=False,
472	   472	                         tools=(keep_tool(documents),))
473	   473	        return await read_positions("\n\n".join(documents or [session.seen]), reference)
474	   474	
475	   475	    async def qa_part() -> QaRecords:
476	   476	        await run_worker(qa_session, _qa_goal(reference), Summary, deadline=deadline,
477	   477	                         max_steps=steps_for(14, deadline), thinking=False, grounded=False,
478	   478	                         tools=(paging_tool(collected),))
479	   479	        return await read_qa(collected.pages or [qa_session.seen], reference)
480	   480	
481	   481	    qa_task = asyncio.create_task(qa_part())
482	   482	    try:
483	   483	        try:
484	   484	            positions = await positions_part()
485	   485	        except Exception as error:
486	   486	            session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_positions_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"[:200])
487	   487	            positions = TenderPositions(positions=[])
488	   488	        if not positions.positions:  # the Q&A worker passed the tender's pages too
489	   489	            await asyncio.wait([qa_task])
490	   490	            try:
491	   491	                positions = await read_positions(qa_session.seen, reference)
492	   492	            except Exception:
493	   493	                positions = TenderPositions(positions=[])
494	   494	        if not positions.positions:
495	   495	            session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_failed")
496	   496	            return None
497	   497	        fmt = positions.number_format or None
498	   498	        if on_facts is not None and not qa_task.done():
499	   499	            early = resolve_tender(positions.positions, QaRecords(), scenario, fmt)
500	   500	            session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_positions", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
501	   501	                                positions=[p.position for p in early.positions])
502	   502	            on_facts(early)
503	   503	        try:
504	   504	            qa = await qa_task
505	   505	        except Exception as error:
506	   506	            session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_qa_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"[:200])
507	   507	            qa = QaRecords()
508	   508	    finally:
509	   509	        if not qa_task.done():
510	   510	            qa_task.cancel()
511	   511	    facts = resolve_tender(positions.positions, qa, scenario, fmt)
512	   512	    facts.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
513	   513	    session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_facts", seconds=facts.seconds,
514	   514	                        positions=[p.model_dump(mode="json") for p in facts.positions])
515	   515	    if on_facts is not None:
516	   516	        on_facts(facts)
517	   517	    return facts

520	   520	async def _research_tender_one(session: SiteSession, reference: str, scenario: datetime, *,
521	   521	                               deadline: float | None = None, on_facts=None) -> TenderFacts | None:
522	   522	    """Positions and Q&A by one worker in one tab."""
523	   523	    started = time.monotonic()
524	   524	    collected = Collected()
525	   525	    documents: list[str] = []
526	   526	    _, notes = await run_worker(session, _goal(reference), Summary, deadline=deadline,
527	   527	                                max_steps=steps_for(20, deadline), thinking=False, grounded=False,
528	   528	                                tools=(paging_tool(collected), keep_tool(documents)))

530	   530	        documents = [session.seen]
531	   531	    qa_pages = collected.pages or [session.seen]  # without collect_pages: the answers it saw itself

572	   572	    """Rules 1, 13, 14 and the Q&A keys: latest dated answer per position and key, withdrawn ones ignored."""
573	   573	    scenario = _aware(scenario)

593	   593	            unit_text=p.unit, tender_quantity=original, quantity=final, quantity_answer=source,
594	   594	            condition_group=_latest_key(qa.condition_groups, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
595	   595	            packaging_key=_latest_key(qa.packaging_tariffs, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
596	   596	            commitment_key=_latest_key(qa.delivery_commitments, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
597	   597	            setup_pool_key=_latest_key(qa.setup_pools, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
598	   598	            bonus_key=_latest_key(qa.project_bonuses, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
599	   599	            setup_fee=fee))
600	   600	    amendments = [Amendment(date=_aware(a.date), revision=a.revision, requirement=a.requirement,

602	   602	                                        _decimal_or_text(a.value, fmt)})

   162	class Collected:
   163	    pages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
   164	
   165	    def add(self, view: str) -> bool:
   166	        """Keep a page view; False when it adds nothing new (past the end a list repeats a page it showed)."""
   167	        new = _normal(view)
   168	        earlier = [_normal(p) for p in self.pages]
   169	        if new in earlier:
   170	            return False
   171	        if earlier and set(earlier[-1].splitlines()) <= set(new.splitlines()):  # "load more" grew the list
   172	            self.pages[-1] = view

   189	def paging_tool(collected: Collected):
   190	    """A tool that pages through the result set the model is looking at, by repeating the control it names."""
   191	
   192	    async def collect_pages(ctx: RunContext[Deps], next_ref: str) -> str:
   193	        """Collect the whole list you are looking at: give the ref of its "next page" or "load more" control. The
   194	        control is clicked until the list ends; every page is kept for reading afterwards. Call it once, on the
   195	        list's first page."""
   196	        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
   197	        control = _control(session.view, next_ref)
   198	        if control is None:
   199	            return f"No control {next_ref} in the latest view; use a ref from the latest view."
   200	        kind, name = control
   201	        collected.add(session.view)
   202	        ref, pages = next_ref, 1
   203	        for _ in range(MAX_PAGES):
   204	            before = _normal(session.view)
   205	            await session.act("click", ref, _click)
   206	            for _ in range(4):  # a list inside a frame can update a moment after the click settled
   207	                if _normal(session.view) != before:
   208	                    break
   209	                await asyncio.sleep(0.7)
   210	                await session.look()
   211	            if not collected.add(session.view):
   212	                break
   213	            pages += 1
   214	            same = [r for r, k, n in REF_LINE.findall(session.view) if k == kind and n == name]
   215	            if not same:
   216	                break
   217	            ref = same[0]
   218	        session.trace.event(session.name, "collect_pages", control=name, pages=len(collected.pages))
   219	        session.trace.event(session.name, "collected", quiet=True, pages=collected.pages)
   220	        text = collected.text

   228	async def open_and_keep(session: SiteSession, urls: list[str], kept: list[str]) -> list[str]:
   229	    """Open each chosen URL in a temporary tab of the session's browser context, side by side, and keep its text."""
   230	
   231	    async def one(url: str) -> str:
   232	        tab = SiteSession(session.site, session.context, session.trace)
   233	        page = await session.context.new_page()
   234	        tab._watch(page)
   235	        try:
   236	            await tab._goto(url)
   237	            view = await tab.look()
   238	            # An embedded document that did not render in place (e.g. a lazy reading pane) is part of the chosen
   239	            # page: open it on its own and add its text.
   240	            for src in EMPTY_FRAME.findall(view)[:3]:
   241	                await tab._goto(urljoin(url, src))

   244	        finally:
