                                      min_order_value=_num(c.min_order_value, latest))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
        return used
    if name == "metal_indices":
        # Rule 28: the latest message per code, with every window it lists for that code.
        latest: dict[str, MailRecord] = {}
        for rec in valid:
            for rate in rec.content.rates:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                latest[rate.code.strip()] = rec
        for code, rec in latest.items():
            facts.metal_indices[code] = [
                MetalIndexRate(rate=_num(r.rate, rec), valid_from=parse_date(r.valid_from) if r.valid_from else None,
                               valid_to=parse_date(r.valid_to) if r.valid_to else None)
                for r in rec.content.rates if r.code.strip() == code]  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            used.add(id(rec))
        return used
    entries = "groups" if name == "condition_rules" else "entries"
    for key, (e, rec) in latest_per_key(valid, entries).items():
        used.add(id(rec))
        if name == "condition_rules":
            facts.discount_scopes[key] = e.discount_scope  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        elif name == "end_reserves":
            facts.end_reserves[key] = Reserve(revision=e.revision,  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                                              reserve_per_end_mm=_num(e.reserve_per_end, rec))  # type: ignore
        elif name == "packaging":
            facts.packaging[key] = PackagingTariff(price_per_carton=_num(e.price_per_carton, rec))  # type: ignore
        elif name == "commitments":
            facts.commitments[key] = DeliveryCommitment(
                material_number=e.material_number,  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                ceiling=parse_int(e.ceiling_pieces, rec.number_format or None),  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                lead_time_weeks=parse_int(e.lead_time_weeks))  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        elif name == "fx":
            facts.fx_rates[key] = _num(e.eur_per_unit, rec)  # type: ignore[attr-defined,assignment]
        elif name == "setup_pools":
            facts.setup_pools[key] = PoolTerms(fee=_num(e.fee, rec), allocation=e.allocation,  # type: ignore
                                               tie_order=e.tie_order, rest_base=e.rest_base)  # type: ignore
        else:
            facts.project_bonuses[key] = BonusTerms(
                bands=[BonusBand(lower=_num(b.lower, rec), upper=_num(b.upper, rec), percent=_num(b.percent, rec))
                       for b in e.bands],  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                include_surcharge=e.basis_includes_surcharge)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    return used


def resolve_mail(results: list[KindResult], reference: str, domain: str, scenario: datetime, mailbox: str
                 ) -> MailFacts:
    facts = MailFacts(mailbox=mailbox)
    scenario = _aware(scenario)
    if not domain:  # never drop what was read for a missing address: the messages name their recipient
        domain = bidder_domain(mailbox, [r for res in results for r in res.records])
        facts.problems.append(f"mailbox address not shown; bidder domain from the recipients: {domain or 'none'}")
    for res in results:
        kind = res.kind
        facts.seconds[kind.name] = res.seconds
        valid = valid_records(res.records, reference, kind, domain, scenario)
        try:
            used = _apply(facts, kind, valid)
        except ParseError as error:
            facts.problems.append(f"{kind.name}: {error}")
            used = set()
        for rec in res.records:
            facts.sources.append(Source(kind=kind.name, subject=rec.subject, sender=rec.sender, sent_at=rec.sent_at,
                                        reference=rec.reference, is_record=rec.is_record,
                                        has_content=rec.content is not None, used=id(rec) in used))
    return facts


async def research_mail(sessions: list[SiteSession], reference: str, scenario: datetime, brief: str, *,
                        findings: str = "", kinds: list[Kind] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None
                        ) -> MailFacts:
    """The record kinds a model plans from the brief (or `kinds`, planned earlier with `plan_searches`), searched
    in parallel over the given webmail tabs (one kind per tab at a time)."""
    address = asyncio.create_task(mailbox_address(sessions[0]))
    if kinds is None:
        kinds = await plan_searches(brief, {sessions[0].name: sessions[0].site["url"]}, findings)
    elsewhere = [k for k in kinds if k.site != sessions[0].name]  # the plan put these on another website
    kinds = [k for k in kinds if k.site == sessions[0].name]
    sessions[0].trace.event(sessions[0].name, "mail_plan", kinds=[f"{k.name}: {k.subject} / {k.sender}" for k in kinds],
                            elsewhere=[f"{k.name} on {k.site}" for k in elsewhere])
    queue: asyncio.Queue[Kind] = asyncio.Queue()
    for kind in kinds:
        queue.put_nowait(kind)
    results: list[KindResult] = []

    async def tab(session: SiteSession) -> None:
        while not queue.empty() and (deadline is None or time.monotonic() < deadline - 20):
            kind = queue.get_nowait()
            try:
                results.append(await research_kind(session, kind, reference, deadline=deadline))
            except Exception as error:  # one failed kind must not cost the others
                session.trace.event(session.name, "mail_kind_failed", record_kind=kind.name,
                                    error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")

    await asyncio.gather(*(tab(s) for s in sessions))
    mailbox = await address
    facts = resolve_mail(results, reference, bidder_domain(mailbox, []), scenario, mailbox)
    facts.problems += [f"{k.name}: planned on website {k.site}, not researched here" for k in elsewhere]
    return facts

class PositionClauses(BaseModel):
    """calc.PositionInput fields the tender Q&A and the mails decide (material and prices come from elsewhere)."""
    position: str
    quantity: int
    unit: str
    discount_scope: DiscountScope
    setup_fee: Decimal
    packaging: PackagingTariff | None
    commitment: DeliveryCommitment | None
    problems: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class BidClauses(BaseModel):
    """calc.BidInput fields from the mails, plus per-position clauses and what could not be resolved."""
    approval: Approval | None
    fx_rates: dict[str, Decimal]
    metal_indices: dict[str, list[MetalIndexRate]]
    setup_pool: SetupPool | None
    project_bonus: ProjectBonus | None
    positions: list[PositionClauses]
    problems: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def bid_clauses(tender: TenderFacts, mail: MailFacts) -> BidClauses:
    problems: list[str] = []
    positions = []
    for p in tender.positions:
        own: list[str] = []
        scope = DiscountScope.BASE_ONLY
        if p.condition_group:
            if p.condition_group in mail.discount_scopes:
                scope = mail.discount_scopes[p.condition_group]
            else:
                own.append(f"condition group {p.condition_group} not in the Konditionsregeln")
        packaging = mail.packaging.get(p.packaging_key) if p.packaging_key else None
        if p.packaging_key and packaging is None:
            own.append(f"packaging tariff {p.packaging_key} not found")
        commitment = mail.commitments.get(p.commitment_key) if p.commitment_key else None
        if p.commitment_key and commitment is None:
            own.append(f"commitment {p.commitment_key} not found")
        positions.append(PositionClauses(position=p.position, quantity=p.quantity, unit=p.unit.value,
                                         discount_scope=scope, setup_fee=p.setup_fee, packaging=packaging,
                                         commitment=commitment, problems=own))

    def one(keys: set[str], table: dict, what: str):
        if len(keys) > 1:
            problems.append(f"several {what} keys {sorted(keys)}; calc takes one")
        key = next(iter(sorted(keys)), None)
        if key is not None and key not in table:
            problems.append(f"{what} {key} not found in the mails")
        return key, table.get(key) if key else None

    pool_key, pool = one({p.setup_pool_key for p in tender.positions if p.setup_pool_key}, mail.setup_pools,
                         "setup pool")
    setup_pool = None
    if pool is not None:
        setup_pool = SetupPool(fee=pool.fee, allocation=pool.allocation, tie_order=pool.tie_order,
                               rest_base=pool.rest_base,
                               members=[p.position for p in tender.positions if p.setup_pool_key == pool_key])
    bonus_key, bonus = one({p.bonus_key for p in tender.positions if p.bonus_key}, mail.project_bonuses,
                           "project bonus")
    project_bonus = None
    if bonus is not None:
        project_bonus = ProjectBonus(bands=bonus.bands, include_surcharge=bonus.include_surcharge,
                                     members=[p.position for p in tender.positions if p.bonus_key == bonus_key])
    return BidClauses(approval=mail.approval, fx_rates=mail.fx_rates, metal_indices=mail.metal_indices,
                      setup_pool=setup_pool, project_bonus=project_bonus, positions=positions, problems=problems)

def _positions(answer: dict | None, desk: PositionDesk, filled: bool, prepared: bool = False) -> str:
    """
    The decision and position part of the requirements: before the form phase, how to enter them; after it, what
    the review must show (the positions actually entered, all others omitted, the total of the entered ones).
    """
    discount = german((answer or {}).get("discount_percent") or 0)
    if answer and answer.get("decision") == "no_bid":
        back = (" If the form shows a position step (an earlier pass chose the main offer before the decision was "
                "known), go back with the form's back button to the offer-type step and choose the declaration "
                "there: going back only clears steps that hold nothing yet;" if prepared and not filled else "")
        return ("- decision: no bid: choose the form's declaration that you do not submit an offer (not a main or "
                f"alternative offer); no positions;{back}\n- discount {discount} and net total 0,00;")
    head = "- decision: bid (main offer, not an alternative offer);\n"
    if filled and desk.entered:
        return head + (f"- exactly {len(desk.entered)} position(s) entered, each with these values:\n"
                       f"{desk.expected()}\n"
                       "- every other position omitted, and no added or extra position;\n"
                       f"- discount {discount} and net total {german(desk.total())} (German number format; never a "
                       "gross amount);")
    if not desk.entries:
        return head + ("- leave every position out with the form's option to omit a position (where the form shows "
                       "one position per step, omit each in turn); do not configure materials, prices or lead times, "
                       f"and never use options that add positions;\n- discount {discount} and net total 0,00 (German "
                       "number format);")
    names = sorted({key for entry in desk.entries.values() for key in entry} - {"position"})
    if desk.plan.fields and desk.next_button:
        mapping = ("- configure_position() already knows which control takes which value and the buttons to apply a "
                   "choice and to save (an earlier pass mapped them on a position page): call it with the position "
                   "number alone; add fields only if it reports a control it cannot find;\n")
    else:
        mapping = f"- configure_position() needs, once, {mapping_guide(names)}\n"
    return head + f"""- enter exactly these positions: {', '.join(sorted(desk.entries))}. The form shows one position
  at a time, in its own order (often not this list's order). On every position page, first call
  configure_position() with the number the page shows: it enters all values of a position of this bid and saves it
  with the next/continue button you name, or tells you to omit it. Never omit a position of this list unless
  configure_position() told you to omit that very position. Never pick options or type position values yourself;
{mapping}- leave out, with the form's option to omit a position, every other position and any position where
  configure_position() reports a problem it cannot resolve. Never use options that add positions; if the form
  shows an extra position you did not ask for, remove it or leave it out;
- discount {discount}; net total: the latest figure configure_position() reports for the positions entered so
  far (net_total() repeats it; pass positions you entered but left out after all). Enter both exactly as given
  (German number format), never a sum you work out yourself, a gross amount or a sum the page proposes;"""


def mapping_guide(names) -> str:
    """How to map a position page's controls to value names (configure_position and map_position_form)."""
    return f"""which control takes which value: map each control's label (as your view shows
  it) to one of these value names: {', '.join(names)}. Choices that open further choices (attributes of the
  material) map to the attribute with the same meaning; the material/catalogue number control to material_number;
  unit price, base price, surcharge, packaging and the bonus or rebate for the whole position to unit_price,
  base_unit_price, surcharge_per_unit, packaging_per_unit and rebate_total; lead time to lead_time_weeks. Leave out
  controls with no matching value. Also name the button that applies a choice so the next one opens, and the
  button that saves the position and goes on to the next step (not the ones that omit or add a position);"""

async def submit_bid(bid_session: SiteSession, mailbox: Mailbox, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float,
                     answer: dict | None = None, attributes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None = None,
                     flow: "BidFlow | None" = None) -> SubmissionResult | None:
    """
    Enter the calculated `answer` (calc's BidResult.answer()), sign and submit it. Positions the answer does not
    give completely, or that fail to enter, are omitted; without an answer every position is omitted (discount 0,
    total 0). `attributes` holds per position number the chosen material's attributes (e.g. its dimensions), which
    the form's choices lead through to the catalogue number. `flow` is the BidFlow that already did the steps
    before the positions (and the address lookup) while the research ran.
    """
    desk = flow.desk if flow else PositionDesk({}, deadline)
    desk.entries = complete_positions(answer or {}, attributes)
    prepared = bool(flow and flow.ready)
    address = flow.contact_address() if flow else asyncio.create_task(mailbox.address())
    try:  # the lookup takes a step or two; knowing the address up front saves the bid worker a round trip
        email = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(address), ADDRESS_WAIT)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        email = ""
    if email:
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + email  # it comes from another website; let results use it

    async def bidder_contact_email(reason: str = "") -> str:
        """The bidder's contact email address, read from the bidder's own webmail."""
        found = await address
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + found
        return found or "not found: the webmail did not show it"

    async def request_signing_tan(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str) -> str:
        """
        Click the website's control that requests the signing TAN (its ref in the latest view), then fetch that
        TAN from the bidder's webmail. Returns the page after the request and the TAN: enter it right away (it is
        valid for five minutes, and any new request invalidates it).
        """
        before = set(bid_session.view.splitlines())
        view = await browser_tools.click(ctx, ref)
        answer = " ".join(line.strip() for line in bid_session.view.splitlines()
                          if line.strip() and line not in before and "[e" not in line)[:400]
        found = await mailbox.tan(answer)
        if not found:
            return f"{view}\n\nNo TAN found in the webmail. Request a new TAN with this tool again."
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + found.tan
        return f"{view}\n\nTAN from the webmail: {found.tan} (message {found.subject!r}, received {found.received})."

    tools = ((bidder_contact_email,) if not email else ()) + desk.tools
    batch = os.environ.get("AGENT_FILL_IN", "1") != "0"
    if batch:
        tools += (fill_in,)
    several = ("Enter everything a page asks for with one fill_in() call (all its fields, boxes and per-row "
               "buttons), then move on.\n" if batch else "")
    form_goal = f"""Fill in the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} on this website, following the brief's
submission steps below, up to the final review and signing step. Every value of this bid is already researched
and calculated; you only enter it: do not open documents, questions or other pages to check or research anything.
{EARLIER_PASS if prepared else ""}For this bid:
{_requirements(briefing, email, answer, desk, prepared=prepared)}
{several}Stop at the final review with the signing step: do not request a TAN and do not submit there.
Return as soon as that page shows. Refs change with every view: read a button's label in the latest view before
clicking it.

Brief's submission steps:
{briefing.submission_steps}"""
    left = deadline - time.monotonic()
    # the form never eats the signing reserve; with little time left, half of it still goes to the form
    form_deadline = deadline - SIGNING_RESERVE if left > SIGNING_RESERVE + 90 else time.monotonic() + left / 2
    # not grounded: the result is a status, and its notes quote our own figures ("5,00" refused four times, 30 s,
    # after which the model went back a step looking for it)
    ready, _ = await run_worker(bid_session, form_goal, FormReady, deadline=form_deadline, grounded=False,
                                max_steps=45 + 3 * len(desk.entries), notes=False,
                                thinking=llm.thinking("form", False), tools=tools)

    requirements = _requirements(briefing, email, answer, desk, filled=True)
    at_review = bool(ready and ready.at_signing_step)

    async def logged_check(view: str) -> None:  # a record for the run logs only: signing never waits for it
        check = await check_summary(view, requirements)
        bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "summary_check", **(check.model_dump() if check else {}))

    checking = asyncio.create_task(logged_check(bid_session.view)) if at_review else None
    if checking is None:
        bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "summary_check")
    if at_review:
        # The review is signed as it stands, whatever the check says: a false alarm sent signing back and forth
        # between steps until its step cap (run 0d2d, ~100 s), and going back clears the later steps anyway.
        task = ("The form was filled in up to the signing step by an earlier pass; the current view shows its "
                "summary. Sign it as it stands: do not change, re-enter or re-check anything and never go back to "
                "earlier steps (that clears them); if the signing step is not on screen, go forward to it.")
    else:
        task = ("An earlier pass started filling in the form but may not have finished; continue from the current "
                "view, and check the summary against the requirements below." +
                (f" It reported: {ready.open_points}" if ready and ready.open_points else ""))
    if os.environ.get("AGENT_STOP_BEFORE_SIGN") == "1":  # local timing runs: never request a TAN (shared webmail)
        address.cancel()
        if checking is not None:
            await checking
        return None
    must = "" if at_review else f"The bid must be:\n{requirements}\n"
    review_goal = f"""Sign and submit the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} on this website. {task}
{must}Request the signing TAN only with request_signing_tan(ref of the website's TAN request button), never by clicking
that button yourself; enter the TAN it returns at once and submit bindingly. Browser confirmation dialogs are
accepted for you. Return once the website confirms the submission (or shows why it failed).

Brief's submission steps:
{briefing.submission_steps}"""
    result = None
    try:
        result, _ = await run_worker(bid_session, review_goal, SubmissionResult, deadline=deadline,
                                     max_steps=15 if at_review else 30, notes=False,
                                     thinking=llm.thinking("sign", False),
                                     tools=(request_signing_tan,) if at_review else (*tools, request_signing_tan))
    except Exception as error:  # in a run, the platform closes the model token once the bid is in
        bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "stopped", reason=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
    if not (result and result.submitted) and deadline - time.monotonic() > LAST_CHANCE:
        # the signing pass ran out of steps or got stuck: one short pass that only signs what is on screen
        last_goal = f"""Submit the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} now, as it stands. Do not change or
re-check any entry and never go back to earlier steps. If the signing step is not on screen, go forward to it.
Request the signing TAN with request_signing_tan(ref of the TAN request button), enter the TAN it returns at once
and submit bindingly. Return once the website confirms the submission (or shows why it failed)."""
        bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "last_chance", seconds_left=round(deadline - time.monotonic()))
        try:
            result, _ = await run_worker(bid_session, last_goal, SubmissionResult, deadline=deadline, max_steps=15,
                                         notes=False, thinking=False, tools=(request_signing_tan,))
        except Exception as error:
            bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "stopped",
                                    reason=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
    for pending in (address, checking):
        if pending is not None and not pending.done():
            pending.cancel()
    return result


EARLIER_PASS = """An earlier pass already did the steps before the positions (bidder data, the main offer as offer type)
and stopped on the first position step, which the current view should show: continue from there. If the view
shows an earlier step instead (the portal session was renewed), do those steps again.
"""
PREPARE_SECONDS = 180  # at most this long for the steps before the positions, while the research runs
KEEPALIVE_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("AGENT_KEEPALIVE_SECONDS", "40"))  # unsaved form steps die with the session
PREPARES = 3  # passes at most: the first and two after a lost session
FINISH_WAIT = 45  # seconds the bid waits for a pass still on the form when the research ends
# the website's start page fetched from the tab (its cookies, no navigation): [final url, html]
KEEPALIVE_JS = ("async () => { const r = await fetch(location.origin + '/', {credentials: 'same-origin'}); "
                "return [r.url, await r.text()]; }")
SIGNED_OUT = re.compile(r"<input[^>]*type=[\"']?password", re.IGNORECASE)


class PrepareResult(BaseModel):
    at_positions: bool = Field(description="True when the page now shows the first step that asks for position "
                                           "values, the discount or the total")
    step: str = Field(description="The step the page shows now, in a few words")


class BidFlow:
    """
    The bid form overlapped with the research. Right after the briefing, a worker (the model) does the form's steps
    that need no calculated value (bidder data with the contact address, expression of interest, the main offer as
    offer type) and maps the controls of the first position page, then stops there. While the research runs, a
    cheap background request keeps the portal session (and with it the unsaved wizard state) alive; when the
    session is lost anyway, the page is reloaded and the steps are done again. finish() then enters the answer from
    the position step on, checks and signs (submit_bid). If the research ends in no_bid, the form worker goes back
    to the offer type, which clears only empty steps. AGENT_FORM_OVERLAP=0 turns this off.
    """

    def __init__(self, session: SiteSession, mailbox: Mailbox, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float):
        self.session, self.mailbox, self.briefing, self.deadline = session, mailbox, briefing, deadline
        self.desk = PositionDesk({}, deadline)
        self.address: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.task: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.ready = False  # a pass stopped at the positions and the session has not been lost since
        self.preparing = False
        self.passes = 0

    def start(self) -> None:
        self.address = asyncio.create_task(self.mailbox.address())
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_FORM_OVERLAP", "1") != "0":
            self.task = asyncio.create_task(self._run())

    def contact_address(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """The address lookup; started again when the first one found nothing (e.g. the webmail was still down)."""
        if self.address is None or (self.address.done() and (self.address.cancelled() or not self.address.result())):
            self.address = asyncio.create_task(self.mailbox.address())
        return self.address

    def _event(self, kind: str, **data) -> None:
        self.session.trace.event("bid_flow", kind, **data)

    async def _run(self) -> None:
        while self.passes < PREPARES and self.deadline - time.monotonic() > SIGNING_RESERVE + 300:
            try:
                await self._prepare()
                if not self.ready:
                    return
                await self._keep_alive()  # returns only when the session was lost
                async with self.session.lock:  # sign in again and show where the wizard stands now
                    await self.session._goto(self.session.page.url)
            except Exception as error:  # e.g. a model error: another pass; at worst the form starts from scratch
                self.preparing = self.ready = False
                self._event("failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:300]}")
                await asyncio.sleep(5)
        self.preparing = False

    async def _prepare(self) -> None:
        self.passes += 1
        self.preparing, self.ready = True, False
        started = time.monotonic()
        address = self.contact_address()

        async def bidder_contact_email(reason: str = "") -> str:
            """The bidder's contact email address, read from the bidder's own webmail."""
            found = await address
            self.session.seen += "\n" + found
            return found or "not found: the webmail did not show it"

        b = self.briefing
        goal = f"""Prepare the bid for tender {b.tender_reference} on this website while its values are still being
calculated. Follow the brief's submission steps below, but only those that need no calculated value: express
interest if the website asks for it, open the bid submission, register the bidder with company name
{b.company_name!r}, VAT id {b.vat_id!r} and the contact email from bidder_contact_email(), and choose the main offer
as the offer type (not an alternative offer, not a declaration that you do not bid). Save each of these steps
with the form's next/continue button. Do not open documents, questions or other pages.
Stop at the first step that asks for position values (materials, quantities, prices, lead times), the discount or
the total: enter, choose, omit, add or save nothing there. If that step shows one position, call
map_position_form() once with {mapping_guide(VALUE_NAMES)}
Then return. Refs change with every view: read a button's label in the latest view before clicking it.

Brief's submission steps:
{b.submission_steps}"""
        tools = (bidder_contact_email, self.desk.map_position_form, fill_in)
        until = min(started + PREPARE_SECONDS, self.deadline - SIGNING_RESERVE - 240)
        result, _ = await run_worker(self.session, goal, PrepareResult, deadline=until, max_steps=20, notes=False,
                                     grounded=False,
                                     thinking=llm.thinking("form", False), tools=tools)
        self.ready = bool(result and result.at_positions)
        self.preparing = False
        self._event("prepared", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), at_positions=self.ready,
                    step=result.step if result else None, mapped=bool(self.desk.plan.fields), passes=self.passes)

    async def _keep_alive(self) -> None:
        """A light request to the website every KEEPALIVE_SECONDS; returns once the session is found signed out."""
        while True:
            await asyncio.sleep(KEEPALIVE_SECONDS)
            try:  # from inside the page: the sandbox resolves the websites only in the browser, not in this process
                url, body = await asyncio.wait_for(self.session.page.evaluate(KEEPALIVE_JS), 20)
            except Exception as error:  # a slow website: try again next time
                self._event("keepalive_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
                continue
            if SIGNED_OUT.search(body):
                self.ready = False
                self._event("session_lost", url=url)
                return

    async def finish(self, answer: dict | None, attributes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None
                     ) -> SubmissionResult | None:
        """Enter the research's answer from where the form stands, check and sign."""
        if self.task is not None:
            waited = time.monotonic()
            while self.preparing and time.monotonic() - waited < FINISH_WAIT:  # a pass is still on the form
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
            self.task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(self.task, return_exceptions=True)
            self._event("handover", ready=self.ready, waited=round(time.monotonic() - waited, 1))
        return await submit_bid(self.session, self.mailbox, self.briefing, self.deadline, answer, attributes,
                                flow=self)

                   "number alone; add fields only if it reports a control it cannot find;\n")

  configure_position() told you to omit that very position. Never pick options or type position values yourself;

    prepared = bool(flow and flow.ready)
    address = flow.contact_address() if flow else asyncio.create_task(mailbox.address())
    try:  # the lookup takes a step or two; knowing the address up front saves the bid worker a round trip
        email = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(address), ADDRESS_WAIT)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        email = ""
    if email:
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + email  # it comes from another website; let results use it

    async def bidder_contact_email(reason: str = "") -> str:
        """The bidder's contact email address, read from the bidder's own webmail."""
        found = await address
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + found
        return found or "not found: the webmail did not show it"

    async def request_signing_tan(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str) -> str:
        """
        Click the website's control that requests the signing TAN (its ref in the latest view), then fetch that
        TAN from the bidder's webmail. Returns the page after the request and the TAN: enter it right away (it is
        valid for five minutes, and any new request invalidates it).
        """
        before = set(bid_session.view.splitlines())
        view = await browser_tools.click(ctx, ref)
        answer = " ".join(line.strip() for line in bid_session.view.splitlines()
                          if line.strip() and line not in before and "[e" not in line)[:400]
        found = await mailbox.tan(answer)
        if not found:
            return f"{view}\n\nNo TAN found in the webmail. Request a new TAN with this tool again."
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + found.tan
        return f"{view}\n\nTAN from the webmail: {found.tan} (message {found.subject!r}, received {found.received})."

    tools = ((bidder_contact_email,) if not email else ()) + desk.tools
    batch = os.environ.get("AGENT_FILL_IN", "1") != "0"
    if batch:
        tools += (fill_in,)
    several = ("Enter everything a page asks for with one fill_in() call (all its fields, boxes and per-row "
               "buttons), then move on.\n" if batch else "")
    form_goal = f"""Fill in the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} on this website, following the brief's
submission steps below, up to the final review and signing step. Every value of this bid is already researched
and calculated; you only enter it: do not open documents, questions or other pages to check or research anything.
{EARLIER_PASS if prepared else ""}For this bid:
{_requirements(briefing, email, answer, desk, prepared=prepared)}
{several}Stop at the final review with the signing step: do not request a TAN and do not submit there.
Return as soon as that page shows. Refs change with every view: read a button's label in the latest view before
clicking it.

Brief's submission steps:
{briefing.submission_steps}"""
    left = deadline - time.monotonic()
    # the form never eats the signing reserve; with little time left, half of it still goes to the form
    form_deadline = deadline - SIGNING_RESERVE if left > SIGNING_RESERVE + 90 else time.monotonic() + left / 2
    # not grounded: the result is a status, and its notes quote our own figures ("5,00" refused four times, 30 s,
    # after which the model went back a step looking for it)
    ready, _ = await run_worker(bid_session, form_goal, FormReady, deadline=form_deadline, grounded=False,
                                max_steps=45 + 3 * len(desk.entries), notes=False,
                                thinking=llm.thinking("form", False), tools=tools)

    requirements = _requirements(briefing, email, answer, desk, filled=True)
    at_review = bool(ready and ready.at_signing_step)

    async def logged_check(view: str) -> None:  # a record for the run logs only: signing never waits for it
        check = await check_summary(view, requirements)
        bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "summary_check", **(check.model_dump() if check else {}))

    checking = asyncio.create_task(logged_check(bid_session.view)) if at_review else None
    if checking is None:
        bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "summary_check")
    if at_review:
        # The review is signed as it stands, whatever the check says: a false alarm sent signing back and forth
        # between steps until its step cap (run 0d2d, ~100 s), and going back clears the later steps anyway.
        task = ("The form was filled in up to the signing step by an earlier pass; the current view shows its "
                "summary. Sign it as it stands: do not change, re-enter or re-check anything and never go back to "
                "earlier steps (that clears them); if the signing step is not on screen, go forward to it.")
    else:
        task = ("An earlier pass started filling in the form but may not have finished; continue from the current "
                "view, and check the summary against the requirements below." +
                (f" It reported: {ready.open_points}" if ready and ready.open_points else ""))
    if os.environ.get("AGENT_STOP_BEFORE_SIGN") == "1":  # local timing runs: never request a TAN (shared webmail)
        address.cancel()
        if checking is not None:
            await checking
        return None
    must = "" if at_review else f"The bid must be:\n{requirements}\n"
    review_goal = f"""Sign and submit the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} on this website. {task}
{must}Request the signing TAN only with request_signing_tan(ref of the website's TAN request button), never by clicking
that button yourself; enter the TAN it returns at once and submit bindingly. Browser confirmation dialogs are
accepted for you. Return once the website confirms the submission (or shows why it failed).

Brief's submission steps:
{briefing.submission_steps}"""
    result = None
    try:
        result, _ = await run_worker(bid_session, review_goal, SubmissionResult, deadline=deadline,
                                     max_steps=15 if at_review else 30, notes=False,
                                     thinking=llm.thinking("sign", False),
                                     tools=(request_signing_tan,) if at_review else (*tools, request_signing_tan))
    except Exception as error:  # in a run, the platform closes the model token once the bid is in
        bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "stopped", reason=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
    if not (result and result.submitted) and deadline - time.monotonic() > LAST_CHANCE:
        # the signing pass ran out of steps or got stuck: one short pass that only signs what is on screen
        last_goal = f"""Submit the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} now, as it stands. Do not change or
re-check any entry and never go back to earlier steps. If the signing step is not on screen, go forward to it.
Request the signing TAN with request_signing_tan(ref of the TAN request button), enter the TAN it returns at once
and submit bindingly. Return once the website confirms the submission (or shows why it failed)."""
        bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "last_chance", seconds_left=round(deadline - time.monotonic()))
        try:
            result, _ = await run_worker(bid_session, last_goal, SubmissionResult, deadline=deadline, max_steps=15,
                                         notes=False, thinking=False, tools=(request_signing_tan,))
        except Exception as error:
            bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "stopped",
                                    reason=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
    for pending in (address, checking):
        if pending is not None and not pending.done():
            pending.cancel()
    return result


EARLIER_PASS = """An earlier pass already did the steps before the positions (bidder data, the main offer as offer type)
and stopped on the first position step, which the current view should show: continue from there. If the view
shows an earlier step instead (the portal session was renewed), do those steps again.
"""
PREPARE_SECONDS = 180  # at most this long for the steps before the positions, while the research runs
KEEPALIVE_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("AGENT_KEEPALIVE_SECONDS", "40"))  # unsaved form steps die with the session
PREPARES = 3  # passes at most: the first and two after a lost session
FINISH_WAIT = 45  # seconds the bid waits for a pass still on the form when the research ends
# the website's start page fetched from the tab (its cookies, no navigation): [final url, html]
KEEPALIVE_JS = ("async () => { const r = await fetch(location.origin + '/', {credentials: 'same-origin'}); "
                "return [r.url, await r.text()]; }")
SIGNED_OUT = re.compile(r"<input[^>]*type=[\"']?password", re.IGNORECASE)


class PrepareResult(BaseModel):
    at_positions: bool = Field(description="True when the page now shows the first step that asks for position "
                                           "values, the discount or the total")
    step: str = Field(description="The step the page shows now, in a few words")


class BidFlow:
    """
    The bid form overlapped with the research. Right after the briefing, a worker (the model) does the form's steps
    that need no calculated value (bidder data with the contact address, expression of interest, the main offer as
    offer type) and maps the controls of the first position page, then stops there. While the research runs, a
    cheap background request keeps the portal session (and with it the unsaved wizard state) alive; when the
    session is lost anyway, the page is reloaded and the steps are done again. finish() then enters the answer from
    the position step on, checks and signs (submit_bid). If the research ends in no_bid, the form worker goes back
    to the offer type, which clears only empty steps. AGENT_FORM_OVERLAP=0 turns this off.
    """

    def __init__(self, session: SiteSession, mailbox: Mailbox, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float):
        self.session, self.mailbox, self.briefing, self.deadline = session, mailbox, briefing, deadline
        self.desk = PositionDesk({}, deadline)
        self.address: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.task: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.ready = False  # a pass stopped at the positions and the session has not been lost since
        self.preparing = False
        self.passes = 0

    def start(self) -> None:
        self.address = asyncio.create_task(self.mailbox.address())
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_FORM_OVERLAP", "1") != "0":
            self.task = asyncio.create_task(self._run())

    def contact_address(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """The address lookup; started again when the first one found nothing (e.g. the webmail was still down)."""
        if self.address is None or (self.address.done() and (self.address.cancelled() or not self.address.result())):
            self.address = asyncio.create_task(self.mailbox.address())
        return self.address

    def _event(self, kind: str, **data) -> None:
        self.session.trace.event("bid_flow", kind, **data)

    async def _run(self) -> None:
        while self.passes < PREPARES and self.deadline - time.monotonic() > SIGNING_RESERVE + 300:
            try:
                await self._prepare()
                if not self.ready:
                    return
                await self._keep_alive()  # returns only when the session was lost
                async with self.session.lock:  # sign in again and show where the wizard stands now
                    await self.session._goto(self.session.page.url)
            except Exception as error:  # e.g. a model error: another pass; at worst the form starts from scratch
                self.preparing = self.ready = False
                self._event("failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:300]}")
                await asyncio.sleep(5)
        self.preparing = False

    async def _prepare(self) -> None:
        self.passes += 1
        self.preparing, self.ready = True, False
        started = time.monotonic()
        address = self.contact_address()

        async def bidder_contact_email(reason: str = "") -> str:
            """The bidder's contact email address, read from the bidder's own webmail."""
            found = await address
            self.session.seen += "\n" + found
            return found or "not found: the webmail did not show it"

        b = self.briefing
        goal = f"""Prepare the bid for tender {b.tender_reference} on this website while its values are still being
calculated. Follow the brief's submission steps below, but only those that need no calculated value: express
interest if the website asks for it, open the bid submission, register the bidder with company name
{b.company_name!r}, VAT id {b.vat_id!r} and the contact email from bidder_contact_email(), and choose the main offer
as the offer type (not an alternative offer, not a declaration that you do not bid). Save each of these steps
with the form's next/continue button. Do not open documents, questions or other pages.
Stop at the first step that asks for position values (materials, quantities, prices, lead times), the discount or
the total: enter, choose, omit, add or save nothing there. If that step shows one position, call
map_position_form() once with {mapping_guide(VALUE_NAMES)}
Then return. Refs change with every view: read a button's label in the latest view before clicking it.

Brief's submission steps:
{b.submission_steps}"""
        tools = (bidder_contact_email, self.desk.map_position_form, fill_in)
        until = min(started + PREPARE_SECONDS, self.deadline - SIGNING_RESERVE - 240)
        result, _ = await run_worker(self.session, goal, PrepareResult, deadline=until, max_steps=20, notes=False,
                                     grounded=False,
                                     thinking=llm.thinking("form", False), tools=tools)
        self.ready = bool(result and result.at_positions)
        self.preparing = False
        self._event("prepared", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), at_positions=self.ready,
                    step=result.step if result else None, mapped=bool(self.desk.plan.fields), passes=self.passes)

    async def _keep_alive(self) -> None:
        """A light request to the website every KEEPALIVE_SECONDS; returns once the session is found signed out."""
        while True:
            await asyncio.sleep(KEEPALIVE_SECONDS)
            try:  # from inside the page: the sandbox resolves the websites only in the browser, not in this process
                url, body = await asyncio.wait_for(self.session.page.evaluate(KEEPALIVE_JS), 20)
            except Exception as error:  # a slow website: try again next time
                self._event("keepalive_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
                continue
            if SIGNED_OUT.search(body):
                self.ready = False
                self._event("session_lost", url=url)
                return

    async def finish(self, answer: dict | None, attributes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None
                     ) -> SubmissionResult | None:
        """Enter the research's answer from where the form stands, check and sign."""
        if self.task is not None:
            waited = time.monotonic()
            while self.preparing and time.monotonic() - waited < FINISH_WAIT:  # a pass is still on the form
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
            self.task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(self.task, return_exceptions=True)
            self._event("handover", ready=self.ready, waited=round(time.monotonic() - waited, 1))
        return await submit_bid(self.session, self.mailbox, self.briefing, self.deadline, answer, attributes,
                                flow=self)

"""

Builds MUTATED runs from the scouting run and calls the agent's own functions on them, read-only:

- site ids renamed to neutral ids (site-a .. site-d, shuffled), the access list shuffled, the brief's site ids and
  product names (the "(Name, `id`)" pairs) replaced consistently;
- the brief's intro and submission paragraphs reworded and reordered by the model (every value kept), its sections
  reordered and the additional-rule bullets shuffled;
- optionally the URLs the briefing step sees masked, so roles must come from the brief's prose alone.

Checks: `briefing.read_brief` maps the bid and mail roles to the renamed ids and extracts the same reference and
bidder as on the unmutated run; `submit.Mailbox.address` finds the bidder address; a short mail lookup (no TAN) finds
a message for the tender; a short tender read lists the positions. The tender site's context blocks every
state-changing request except sign-in/consent, and every request to a submission or TAN endpoint, so the bid form
is never opened and no TAN is ever requested on the shared scouting account.

From the repo root, with `atira models proxy` running (the scouting logins are loaded from `atira scout --env` when
CHALLENGE_SCOUTING is not set):

1	"""
     2	Fill one bid position in a web form from calculated values: the mechanical part of the bid worker.
     3	
     4	The model reads the form, says which position is on screen and which control takes which value (by the control's
     5	label as its view shows it); `fill_position` then sets the controls in that order. Choices that narrow each other
     6	(select one level, confirm, the next level's options appear) get the confirm button the model named after every
     7	level. Options are matched by value, never by their place in the list, so text-sorted lists ("10, 125, 14, 8") and
     8	look-alike neighbours ("63", "64") do not matter. Nothing here knows a site, a label or a value.
     9	"""
    10	import re
    11	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    12	from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal, InvalidOperation
    13	
    14	from extract import locate
    15	
    16	ZERO_WIDTH = re.compile("[\u200b\u200c\u200d\u2060\ufeff\u00ad]")
    17	CONTROL = re.compile(r'\[(e\d+) (select|textbox|textarea|button|checkbox|radio) "((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"')
    18	NUMBER_OPTION = re.compile(r"^\s*([+-]?\d[\d.,]*)\s*[^\d]*$")
    19	
    20	# Values of a bid position: the answer fields from calc plus the material's attributes (keys of `attributes`).
    21	MONEY_KEYS = {"unit_price", "base_unit_price", "surcharge_per_unit", "packaging_per_unit", "rebate_total"}
    22	COUNT_KEYS = {"quantity", "lead_time_weeks"}
    23	REQUIRED_KEYS = ("position", "material_number", "quantity", "unit_price", "lead_time_weeks")
    24	# the material attributes the form's choices lead through (orchestrator.material_attributes gives these names)
    25	ATTRIBUTE_KEYS = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")
    26	# every value name a position control can take, known before any value is calculated
    27	VALUE_NAMES = (*REQUIRED_KEYS[1:], "base_unit_price", "surcharge_per_unit", "packaging_per_unit", "rebate_total",
    28	               *ATTRIBUTE_KEYS)
    29	
    30	
    31	def clean(text: str) -> str:
    32	    return " ".join(ZERO_WIDTH.sub("", text or "").split()).casefold()
    33	
    34	
    35	def parse_number(text: str) -> Decimal | None:
    36	    """A number written the German way ("1.234,5"), the English way ("1,234.5") or plain; None if it is none."""
    37	    t = ZERO_WIDTH.sub("", text or "").strip().replace(" ", "").replace("\u202f", "").replace("\u00a0", "")
    38	    if not re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d[\d.,]*", t):
    39	        return None
    40	    if "," in t and "." in t:  # the later separator is the decimal one
    41	        t = t.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".") if t.rfind(",") > t.rfind(".") else t.replace(",", "")
    42	    elif "," in t:  # one comma is a decimal comma (German), several are thousands separators
    43	        t = t.replace(",", ".") if t.count(",") == 1 else t.replace(",", "")
    44	    elif t.count(".") > 1:
    45	        t = t.replace(".", "")
    46	    try:
    47	        return Decimal(t)
    48	    except InvalidOperation:
    49	        return None
    50	
    51	
    52	def german(value, places: int = 2) -> str:
    53	    """A number in German notation without thousands separators: 1234.5 -> "1234,50", places=0 -> "1235"."""
    54	    number = Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-places), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    55	    return f"{number:.{places}f}".replace(".", ",")
    56	
    57	
    58	def form_value(key: str, value) -> str:
    59	    """The text a form field takes for a position value: money with two decimals, counts as integers."""
    60	    if key in MONEY_KEYS:
    61	        return german(value, 2)
    62	    if key in COUNT_KEYS:
    63	        return german(value, 0)
    64	    return str(value)
    65	
    66	
    67	def match_option(options: list[dict], wanted: str) -> tuple[dict | None, str]:
    68	    """
    69	    The one option of a select that means `wanted`, or None and why.
    70	
    71	    Tried in order, each must give exactly one option: the same text or value; the same number (an option that is
    72	    a number plus a unit, "3 Wochen" for 3); `wanted` as a whole token of the option text (a catalogue number
    73	    followed by details). Placeholder options (empty value) never match.
    74	    """
    75	    real = [o for o in options if (o.get("value") or "").strip() and not o.get("disabled")]
    76	    want = clean(wanted)
    77	    if not want:
    78	        return None, "no value to choose"
    79	    exact = [o for o in real if clean(o["text"]) == want or clean(o["value"]) == want]
    80	    if len(exact) == 1:
    81	        return exact[0], ""
    82	    number = parse_number(wanted.split()[0]) if wanted.split() else None
    83	    if number is not None and NUMBER_OPTION.match(wanted):
    84	        same = []
    85	        for o in real:
    86	            m = NUMBER_OPTION.match(ZERO_WIDTH.sub("", o["text"]))
    87	            if m and parse_number(m.group(1)) == number:
    88	                same.append(o)
    89	        if len(same) == 1:
    90	            return same[0], ""
    91	        if len(same) > 1:
    92	            return None, f"{len(same)} options equal {wanted!r}"
    93	    token = re.compile(r"(?<![\w-])" + re.escape(want) + r"(?![\w-])")
    94	    hits = [o for o in real if re.search(r"\d", want) and token.search(clean(o["text"]))]
    95	    if len(hits) == 1:
    96	        return hits[0], ""
    97	    if len(hits) > 1:
    98	        return None, f"{len(hits)} options contain {wanted!r}: " + " | ".join(o["text"] for o in hits[:8])
    99	    return None, f"no option means {wanted!r}"
   100	
   101	
   102	def controls(view: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
   103	    """(ref, kind, label) of every form control in a view, in page order."""
   104	    return [(ref, kind, label.replace('\\"', '"')) for ref, kind, label in CONTROL.findall(view)]
   105	
   106	
   107	def find_control(view: str, label: str, kinds: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
   108	    """The ref of the control whose label is `label` (exactly, else the one label that contains it)."""
   109	    want = clean(label)
   110	    found = [(ref, kind, text) for ref, kind, text in controls(view) if not kinds or kind in kinds]
   111	    exact = [c for c in found if clean(c[2]) == want]
   112	    if exact:
   113	        return exact[0][0], ""
   114	    partial = [c for c in found if want and want in clean(c[2])]
   115	    if len(partial) == 1:
   116	        return partial[0][0], ""
   117	    if partial:
   118	        return None, f"{label!r} matches several controls: " + ", ".join(repr(c[2]) for c in partial[:6])
   119	    return None, f"no control labelled {label!r} on the page"
   120	
   121	
   122	def mapping_problems(view: str, fields: dict[str, str], known: set[str], buttons: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> list[str]:
   123	    """
   124	    What is wrong with a control mapping (label -> value name) for the form in `view`: unknown value names, labels
   125	    that name no control (or several), required values left unmapped, buttons not on the page. [] when usable.
   126	    """
   127	    problems = []
   128	    unknown = sorted({name for name in fields.values() if name not in known})
   129	    if unknown:
   130	        problems.append(f"unknown value names {unknown}; use only: {', '.join(sorted(known))}")
   131	    for label in fields:
   132	        ref, why = find_control(view, label, ("select", "textbox", "textarea"))
   133	        if ref is None:
   134	            problems.append(why)
   135	    unmapped = sorted(set(REQUIRED_KEYS[1:]) - set(fields.values()))
   136	    if unmapped:
   137	        problems.append(f"no control mapped for {', '.join(unmapped)}")
   138	    for button in filter(None, buttons):
   139	        ref, why = find_control(view, button, ("button",))
   140	        if ref is None:
   141	            problems.append(why)
   142	    return problems
   143	
   144	
   145	def position_on_page(view: str, position: str) -> bool:
   146	    """
   147	    Whether the page is about this position: its number, as a whole token (01.04 is not 01.041 or 101.04), in a
   148	    heading or in the text above the first choice or field (not among the options further down).
   149	    """
   150	    view = ZERO_WIDTH.sub("", view)
   151	    first = re.search(r"\[e\d+ (select|textarea|checkbox|radio) ", view)
   152	    head = view[:first.start()] if first else view
   153	    head += "\n" + "\n".join(line for line in view.splitlines() if line.startswith("#"))
   154	    return re.search(r"(?<![\w.])" + re.escape(position.strip()) + r"(?![\w]|\.\d)", head) is not None
   155	
   156	
   157	def unmapped(view: str, entry: dict, fields: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
   158	    """
   159	    Answer values of `entry` that no control is mapped to, and the labels of the page's fields (text boxes, lists)
   160	    that no mapping names. Both non-empty means the model probably skipped part of the form (a live run left every
   161	    price breakdown field empty that way).
   162	    """
   163	    mapped = {clean(label) for label in fields}
   164	    names = set(fields.values())
   165	    values = sorted(k for k in entry if k in MONEY_KEYS | COUNT_KEYS | {"material_number"} and k not in names)
   166	    labels = [label for _, kind, label in controls(view)
   167	              if kind in ("select", "textbox", "textarea") and clean(label) not in mapped]
   168	    return values, labels
   169	
   170	
   171	def resolve_position(given: str, numbers, view: str) -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
   172	    """
   173	    Which of the bid's position `numbers` to enter now, and the bid's positions the page shows. The page decides:
   174	    forms show positions in their own order, and a model that expects the bid's order names the next position of
   175	    its list while the page shows another one (live runs omitted correct positions that way). So: the position
   176	    `given` names (also inside a longer label such as "Position 01.04") when the page shows it, else the one bid
   177	    position the page shows, else `given` itself if it is a bid position (the caller reports it is not on the page),
   178	    else None (the page shows none of the bid's positions, or several).
   179	    """
   180	    numbers = [str(n).strip() for n in numbers]
   181	    shown = [n for n in numbers if position_on_page(view, n)]
   182	    given = ZERO_WIDTH.sub("", given or "").strip()
   183	    named = [given] if given in numbers else [
   184	        n for n in numbers if re.search(r"(?<![\w.])" + re.escape(n) + r"(?![\w]|\.\d)", given)]
   185	    if len(named) == 1 and named[0] in shown:
   186	        return named[0], shown
   187	    if len(shown) == 1:
   188	        return shown[0], shown
   189	    if len(named) == 1 and not shown:
   190	        return named[0], shown
   191	    return None, shown
   192	
   193	
   194	def complete_positions(answer: dict, attributes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None = None) -> dict[str, dict]:
   195	    """
   196	    The positions that can be entered, by position number: every required answer field present and, for the
   197	    choices that lead to the material, the material's attributes. Others are left out (omitted in the form).
   198	    """
   199	    if not answer or answer.get("decision") != "bid":
   200	        return {}
   201	    attributes = attributes or {}
   202	    entries = {}
   203	    for pos in answer.get("positions", []):
   204	        if any(pos.get(k) in (None, "") for k in REQUIRED_KEYS):
   205	            continue
   206	        entry = {k: v for k, v in pos.items() if v is not None}
   207	        for key, value in (attributes.get(str(pos["position"])) or {}).items():
   208	            entry.setdefault(key, value)
   209	        entries[str(pos["position"]).strip()] = entry
   210	    return entries
   211	
   212	
   213	@dataclass
   214	class FillPlan:
   215	    """What the model said about the form: control label -> value key, and the button that confirms a choice."""
   216	
   217	    fields: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
   218	    confirm: str = ""
   219	
   220	
   221	async def _select_state(element) -> dict:
   222	    return await element.evaluate(
   223	        "e => ({disabled: e.disabled, options: Array.from(e.options).map(o => ({value: o.value, "
   224	        "text: (o.textContent || '').trim(), selected: o.selected, disabled: o.disabled}))})")
   225	
   226	
   227	async def _confirm(session, plan: FillPlan, view: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
   228	    """Click the button the model named as the confirm of a choice; the new view, or the old one and an error."""
   229	    button, why = find_control(view, plan.confirm, ("button",))
   230	    target = await locate(session.page, button) if button else None
   231	    if target is None:
   232	        return view, why or f"{plan.confirm!r} vanished from the page"
   233	    await target.click(timeout=5000)
   234	    await session.settle()
   235	    return await session.look(), None
   236	
   237	
   238	async def fill_position(session, entry: dict, plan: FillPlan, log: list[str],
   239	                        choices: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> str | None:
   240	    """
   241	    Enter one position's values into the form on screen, control by control in page order; returns an error
   242	    message, or None when every mapped control holds its value.
   243	
   244	    A select mapped to a material attribute (a key that is not an answer field) is a choice that narrows the next
   245	    one: after setting it, `plan.confirm` is clicked so the page offers the next level, and the choice must survive
   246	    that round trip. A control still disabled (a choice from an earlier visit not yet confirmed) gets one confirm.
   247	    `choices` (label -> option text) is the model's pick for such a choice, used only where a worded attribute
   248	    matches no option literally; numbers must match exactly, and answer fields are never overridden.
   249	    """

   252	    # a position counts as entered only with its material, quantity, price and lead time (the material control
   253	    # opens only once the choices before it are made)
   254	    unmapped = sorted(set(REQUIRED_KEYS) - {"position"} - set(plan.fields.values()))
   255	    if unmapped:

   259	    mapping = sorted(plan.fields.items(), key=lambda item: order.get(clean(item[0]), len(order)))
   260	    for label, key in mapping:
   261	        if key not in entry:
   262	            log.append(f"{label}: left empty (this bid gives no value for it, which is fine)")
   263	            continue
   264	        value = form_value(key, entry[key])
   265	        for attempt in range(2):
   266	            ref, why = find_control(view, label, ("select", "textbox", "textarea"))
   267	            element = await locate(session.page, ref) if ref else None
   268	            if element is None and ref is None and key not in REQUIRED_KEYS:

   270	                # pressure, which the form shows only inside the catalogue option): skip it, never fail the

     2	Fill one bid position in a web form from calculated values: the mechanical part of the bid worker.
     3	
     4	The model reads the form, says which position is on screen and which control takes which value (by the control's
     5	label as its view shows it); `fill_position` then sets the controls in that order. Choices that narrow each other
     6	(select one level, confirm, the next level's options appear) get the confirm button the model named after every
     7	level. Options are matched by value, never by their place in the list, so text-sorted lists ("10, 125, 14, 8") and
     8	look-alike neighbours ("63", "64") do not matter. Nothing here knows a site, a label or a value.
     9	"""
    10	import re
    11	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    12	from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal, InvalidOperation

    14	from extract import locate
    15	
    16	ZERO_WIDTH = re.compile("[\u200b\u200c\u200d\u2060\ufeff\u00ad]")

    18	NUMBER_OPTION = re.compile(r"^\s*([+-]?\d[\d.,]*)\s*[^\d]*$")

    20	# Values of a bid position: the answer fields from calc plus the material's attributes (keys of `attributes`).
    21	MONEY_KEYS = {"unit_price", "base_unit_price", "surcharge_per_unit", "packaging_per_unit", "rebate_total"}
    22	COUNT_KEYS = {"quantity", "lead_time_weeks"}
    23	REQUIRED_KEYS = ("position", "material_number", "quantity", "unit_price", "lead_time_weeks")
    24	# the material attributes the form's choices lead through (orchestrator.material_attributes gives these names)
    25	ATTRIBUTE_KEYS = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")
    26	# every value name a position control can take, known before any value is calculated
    27	VALUE_NAMES = (*REQUIRED_KEYS[1:], "base_unit_price", "surcharge_per_unit", "packaging_per_unit", "rebate_total",
    28	               *ATTRIBUTE_KEYS)

    30	
    31	def clean(text: str) -> str:
    32	    return " ".join(ZERO_WIDTH.sub("", text or "").split()).casefold()
    33	
    34	
    35	def parse_number(text: str) -> Decimal | None:
    36	    """A number written the German way ("1.234,5"), the English way ("1,234.5") or plain; None if it is none."""
    37	    t = ZERO_WIDTH.sub("", text or "").strip().replace(" ", "").replace("\u202f", "").replace("\u00a0", "")
    38	    if not re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d[\d.,]*", t):
    39	        return None
    40	    if "," in t and "." in t:  # the later separator is the decimal one
    41	        t = t.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".") if t.rfind(",") > t.rfind(".") else t.replace(",", "")
    42	    elif "," in t:  # one comma is a decimal comma (German), several are thousands separators
    43	        t = t.replace(",", ".") if t.count(",") == 1 else t.replace(",", "")
    44	    elif t.count(".") > 1:
    45	        t = t.replace(".", "")
    46	    try:
    47	        return Decimal(t)
    48	    except InvalidOperation:
    49	        return None
    50	
    51	
    52	def german(value, places: int = 2) -> str:
    53	    """A number in German notation without thousands separators: 1234.5 -> "1234,50", places=0 -> "1235"."""
    54	    number = Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-places), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    55	    return f"{number:.{places}f}".replace(".", ",")

    58	def form_value(key: str, value) -> str:
    59	    """The text a form field takes for a position value: money with two decimals, counts as integers."""
    60	    if key in MONEY_KEYS:

    66	
    67	def match_option(options: list[dict], wanted: str) -> tuple[dict | None, str]:
    68	    """
    69	    The one option of a select that means `wanted`, or None and why.
    70	
    71	    Tried in order, each must give exactly one option: the same text or value; the same number (an option that is
    72	    a number plus a unit, "3 Wochen" for 3); `wanted` as a whole token of the option text (a catalogue number
    73	    followed by details). Placeholder options (empty value) never match.
    74	    """
    75	    real = [o for o in options if (o.get("value") or "").strip() and not o.get("disabled")]
    76	    want = clean(wanted)
    77	    if not want:
    78	        return None, "no value to choose"

    80	    if len(exact) == 1:
    81	        return exact[0], ""
    82	    number = parse_number(wanted.split()[0]) if wanted.split() else None
    83	    if number is not None and NUMBER_OPTION.match(wanted):
    84	        same = []
    85	        for o in real:
    86	            m = NUMBER_OPTION.match(ZERO_WIDTH.sub("", o["text"]))

    94	    hits = [o for o in real if re.search(r"\d", want) and token.search(clean(o["text"]))]

   103	    """(ref, kind, label) of every form control in a view, in page order."""

   107	def find_control(view: str, label: str, kinds: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
   108	    """The ref of the control whose label is `label` (exactly, else the one label that contains it)."""
   109	    want = clean(label)

   114	    partial = [c for c in found if want and want in clean(c[2])]
   115	    if len(partial) == 1:

   122	def mapping_problems(view: str, fields: dict[str, str], known: set[str], buttons: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> list[str]:
   123	    """

   125	    that name no control (or several), required values left unmapped, buttons not on the page. [] when usable.
   126	    """

   129	    if unknown:
   130	        problems.append(f"unknown value names {unknown}; use only: {', '.join(sorted(known))}")
   131	    for label in fields:
   132	        ref, why = find_control(view, label, ("select", "textbox", "textarea"))

   145	def position_on_page(view: str, position: str) -> bool:
   146	    """

class Mailbox:
    """The bidder's webmail, worked by the model on request; one request at a time in its tab."""

    def __init__(self, session: SiteSession, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float):
        self.session, self.briefing, self.deadline = session, briefing, deadline
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.last_tan = ""

    async def address(self) -> str:
        """The bidder's own address, or "" when the webmail cannot tell: never an error that would stop the bid."""
        try:
            async with self.lock:
                found, _ = await run_worker(
                    self.session, "Find the email address of the mailbox you are signed in to (the bidder's own "
                    "address, usually shown as the signed-in account). Return it at once.",
                    MailboxAddress, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=8, notes=False)
        except Exception as error:
            self.session.trace.event(self.session.name, "stopped", reason=f"address: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
            return ""
        return found.address if found else ""

    async def tan(self, answer: str = "") -> SigningTan | None:
        """
        The signing TAN just requested. The sites run on the scenario's clock, so "newest" is the highest request
        number or the top of the list, never a wall-clock time. `answer` is what the bid website said to the request
        (it may name the request), so the mail worker can pick that very message.
        """
        older = f" The TAN {self.last_tan} you returned before is no longer valid." if self.last_tan else ""
        said = (f" The bid website answered the request with: {answer!r}; pick the message for that request."
                if answer else "")
        try:
            return await self._tan(older, said, answer)
        except Exception as error:  # the bid worker asks again; an error here must not stop the bid
            self.session.trace.event(self.session.name, "stopped", reason=f"tan: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
            return None

    async def _tan(self, older: str, said: str, answer: str) -> SigningTan | None:
        async with self.lock:
            async with self.session.lock:  # the list the tab shows predates the request: load it again
                await self.session.revive()
                await self.session._goto(self.session.page.url)
            found, _ = await run_worker(
                self.session, f"A new signing TAN for tender {self.briefing.tender_reference} was just requested."
                f"{said} Open the newest signing TAN message for exactly this tender reference (the highest "
                "request number; new TAN messages are listed without a search, newest first; reload the list once "
                "if it is not there yet), copy the TAN from its text and return it at once. If a preview pane "
                f"stays empty, open the message's own page through its link.{older}",
                SigningTan, context=answer, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=10, notes=False)
        if found:
            self.last_tan = found.tan
        return found


class FormAction(BaseModel):
    ref: str = Field(description="The element's ref in the latest view")
    action: Literal["fill", "select", "check", "uncheck", "click"]
    value: str = Field("", description="fill: the text to type; select: the option's visible text, exactly as the "
                                       "view lists it; empty for check, uncheck and click")


async def _perform(element, step: FormAction) -> None:
    if step.action == "fill":
        await element.fill(step.value, timeout=2000)
    elif step.action == "select":
        if not step.value:
            raise ValueError("select needs the option's visible text as value")
        try:
            await element.select_option(label=step.value, timeout=2000)
        except Exception:
            await element.select_option(step.value, timeout=2000)
    elif step.action in ("check", "uncheck"):
        await element.set_checked(step.action == "check", timeout=2000)
    else:
        try:
            await element.click(timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            await element.evaluate("e => e.click()")


async def fill_in(ctx: RunContext[Deps], actions: list[FormAction]) -> str:
    """
    Do several actions on the current page in one go, in this order: fill textboxes, choose options, tick boxes,
    or click buttons that keep you on this page (such as one per table row). Use refs from the latest view. It
    stops at the first action that fails or that leaves the page, and returns the new view. Put a button that
    moves to the next step only last, or click it on its own.
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    done: list[str] = []
    stop = ""
    async with session.lock:
        page, url, windows = session.page, session.page.url, len(session.pages)
        for step in actions:
            element = await locate(page, step.ref)
            if element is None:
                stop = f"no element {step.ref} (the page changed; use the new view)"
                break
            try:
                await _perform(element, step)
            except Exception as error:

                                 confirm_button: str = "", next_button: str = "",

        next/continue button. `position`: its number as the page shows it. `fields`: control label (exactly as in
        your view) -> value name; needed on the first call, later calls reuse it. `confirm_button`: label of the
        button that applies a choice so the next choice opens. `next_button`: label of the button that saves the

                                       f"value name) for the controls of this form, then call again; do not omit it.")

                                      f"control is mapped to them, while these fields of the page are not mapped: "
                                      f"{'; '.join(labels)}. Call again now with fields that add every one of them "
                                      "that takes such a value (the mapping you gave stays); leave out fields that "
                                      "match none.")

            log: list[str] = []
            try:
                error = await fill_position(session, entry, plan, log, self.picks(position, entry, choices))
            except Exception as exc:  # a slow or changed page: the model decides to retry or omit
                error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
            moved = ""

                view = await session.look()

                target = await locate(session.page, ref) if ref else None
                if target is None:
                    moved = f" Could not save it: {why}; click the form's next/continue button yourself."
                else:
                    await target.click(timeout=5000)
                    await session.settle()
                    moved = f" Saved with {self.next_button!r}; the page below is the form's next step."
            session.trace.event(session.name, "configure_position", position=position, done=log, error=error,
                                moved=moved)

            self.entered.discard(position)

                    "Fix the mapping and call again, or leave the position out with the form's option to omit "
                    f"it. {self.so_far(session)}\n\n{view}")
        self.entered.add(position)
        then = moved or " Check it, then save and continue with the form's next/continue button."
        which = "" if position == asked else f" (the page showed {position}, not {asked!r}; {position} was entered)"
        return (f"Position {position} entered{which}: {'; '.join(log)}.{then} {self.so_far(session)} Still to "
                f"enter when the form shows them: {self.remaining()}.\n\n{view}")

    def remaining(self) -> str:
        """The bid's positions not entered yet: the form may show them in any order; none of them is omitted."""
        left = sorted(set(self.entries) - self.entered, key=position_key)
        return ", ".join(left) or "none"

    def picks(self, position: str, entry: dict, choices: dict[str, str] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
        """
        The model's option picks for this position's worded choices: what it named for this position (a revisit
        needs the same), and what it named for the same control and the same value on an earlier position (a
        "none" attribute that the form words differently comes up again and needs no second failed attempt).
        """
        remembered = self.choices.setdefault(position, {})

                 if entry.get(key) is not None and (clean(label), clean(str(entry[key]))) in self.synonyms}
